jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

• 5 years of experience taking technical products from conception to launch (e.g., ideation to execution, end-to-end, 0 to 1, etc.).

• 5 years of experience in people management, with technical leadership.

• Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience balancing consumer reach with infrastructure constraints (cost, latency, and model optimization).

• Experience in cross-functional leadership, and partnering with teams across organizational boundaries.

• Familiarity with modern machine learning, LLMs, and foundational models (such as Gemini).

About the job
 At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.

In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.

One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

In the AI era, users expect Search to effortlessly Answer, Explore, and Address Anything. To meet these rising expectations, our models need the content.
 The Search Content Platform (SCP) team builds an AI-first content platform to deliver a comprehensive and trustworthy knowledge source. By acquiring third-party data and organizing disparate modalities—such as text, images, videos, and User-Generated Content—into a seamless whole, we make Search AI experiences rich, helpful, and performant.
 Our team's mission is to use AI to revolutionize how we acquire and organize third-party content. As the Group Product Manager for Content Acquisition and Identity, you will manage a team to define the future of Google Search content. You will collaborate with engineering teams in Zurich, Sao Paulo, and Mountain View, and represent the organization to key partners.

In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on. In joining the Search team, you'll have an opportunity to make an impact on billions of people globally.
 Responsibilities

• Lead the product goal, detailed platform requirements for a horizontal content acquisition platform that accelerates third-party (3P) content acquisition while delivering on critical priority verticals such as Sports and Health.

• Enable Search to answer billions of user queries daily by innovating on content identity for the AI era and establishing clear, disambiguated, and precise identities for billions of user queries on Search daily.

• Direct efforts to analyze billions of current and aspirational user queries that lack sufficient content, and prioritize or drive initiatives to bridge these gaps and improve product helpfulness to end users.

• Discuss your knowledge and use of AI tools during the hiring process to demonstrate the AI fluency expected in this role.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 10 anni di esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti o un ruolo tecnico correlato.

• 5 anni di esperienza che prendono prodotti tecnici dal concepimento al lancio (ad esempio, ideazione all'esecuzione, end-to-end, 0 a 1, ecc).

• 5 anni di esperienza nella gestione delle persone, con leadership tecnica.

• Esperienza di integrare gli strumenti generativi AI o le interfacce LLM in flussi di lavoro.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Esperienza di bilanciamento della portata dei consumatori con vincoli di infrastruttura (costo, latenza e ottimizzazione dei modelli).

• Esperienza nella leadership interfunzionale e collaborazione con team attraverso i confini organizzativi.

• Familiarità con l'apprendimento automatico moderno, LLM e modelli fondamentali (come Gemini).

Riguardo al lavoro
A Google, mettiamo i nostri utenti prima. Il mondo cambia sempre, quindi abbiamo bisogno di Product Manager che si adattano continuamente ed emozionano a lavorare su prodotti che colpiscono milioni di persone ogni giorno.

In questo ruolo, lavorerai trasversalmente per guidare i prodotti dal concepimento al lancio collegando i mondi tecnici e aziendali. È possibile abbattere problemi complessi in passi che guidano lo sviluppo del prodotto.

Uno dei tanti motivi per cui Google porta costantemente prodotti innovativi e mutevoli sul mercato è a causa del lavoro collaborativo che facciamo in Product Management. Il nostro team lavora a stretto contatto con ingegneri creativi, designer, marketers, ecc. per aiutare la progettazione e lo sviluppo di tecnologie che migliorano l'accesso alle informazioni del mondo. Siamo responsabili di guidare i prodotti durante tutto il ciclo di esecuzione, concentrandosi specificamente sull'analisi, il posizionamento, l'imballaggio, la promozione e la sartoria delle nostre soluzioni ai nostri utenti.

Nell'era dell'intelligenza artificiale, gli utenti si aspettano che la ricerca risponda senza sforzo, esplora e affronta qualsiasi cosa. Per soddisfare queste crescenti aspettative, i nostri modelli hanno bisogno del contenuto.
Il team Search Content Platform (SCP) costruisce una piattaforma di contenuti AI-first per fornire una fonte di conoscenza completa e affidabile. Con l'acquisizione di dati di terze parti e l'organizzazione di modalità disparate, come testo, immagini, video e Contenuti generati dall'utente, in un insieme senza soluzione di continuità, rendiamo le esperienze di Search AI ricche, utili e performanti.
La missione del nostro team è quella di utilizzare l'IA per rivoluzionare come acquisiamo e organizziamo contenuti di terze parti. Come Group Product Manager per l'acquisizione dei contenuti e l'identità, gestirai un team per definire il futuro dei contenuti di Google Search. Potrai collaborare con team di ingegneria a Zurigo, San Paolo e Mountain View, e rappresentare l'organizzazione per partner chiave.

In Google Search, stiamo rivisitando ciò che significa cercare informazioni – in qualsiasi modo e ovunque. Per farlo, abbiamo bisogno di risolvere complesse sfide ingegneristiche ed espandere la nostra infrastruttura, mantenendo un'esperienza universalmente accessibile e utile a cui le persone in tutto il mondo si affidano. Entrando nel team di ricerca, avrai l'opportunità di avere un impatto su miliardi di persone a livello globale.

responsabilità

• Condurre l'obiettivo del prodotto, i requisiti di piattaforma dettagliati per una piattaforma di acquisizione di contenuti orizzontale che accelera l'acquisizione di contenuti di terze parti (3P), offrendo al contempo verticali prioritari critici come Sport e Salute.

• Abilitare la ricerca per rispondere a miliardi di query utente al giorno innovando sull'identità dei contenuti per l'era dell'IA e stabilire identità chiare, disambiguate e precise per miliardi di domande degli utenti sulla ricerca quotidiana.

• Gli sforzi diretti per analizzare miliardi di domande attuali e ambiziose degli utenti che mancano di contenuti sufficienti, e priorizzare o guidare iniziative per colmare queste lacune e migliorare la disponibilità dei prodotti agli utenti finali.

• Discutete la vostra conoscenza e l'uso degli strumenti AI durante il processo di assunzione per dimostrare la fluidità AI prevista in questo ruolo.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 10 Jahre Erfahrung im Produktmanagement oder einer damit verbundenen technischen Rolle.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit technischen Produkten von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung (z. B. Ideation bis zur Ausführung, End-to-End, 0 bis 1 usw.).

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Personalmanagement, mit technischer Führung.

• Erleben Sie die Integration generativer KI-Tools oder LLM-Schnittstellen in Workflows.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Erleben Sie einen Ausgleich zwischen Verbraucherreichweite und Infrastrukturbeschränkungen (Kosten, Latenz und Modelloptimierung).

• Erfahrung in funktionsübergreifender Führung und Partnerschaft mit Teams über organisatorische Grenzen hinweg.

• Vertrautheit mit modernem maschinellem Lernen, LLMs und grundlegenden Modellen (wie Gemini).

Über den Job
Bei Google stehen unsere Nutzer an erster Stelle. Die Welt verändert sich ständig, daher brauchen wir Produktmanager, die sich ständig anpassen und begeistert sind, an Produkten zu arbeiten, die jeden Tag Millionen von Menschen betreffen.

In dieser Rolle arbeiten Sie funktionsübergreifend, um Produkte von der Konzeption bis zur Einführung zu führen, indem Sie die technische und geschäftliche Welt verbinden. Sie können komplexe Probleme in Schritte unterteilen, die die Produktentwicklung vorantreiben.

Einer der vielen Gründe, warum Google konsequent innovative, weltverändernde Produkte auf den Markt bringt, ist die Zusammenarbeit im Produktmanagement. Unser Team arbeitet eng mit Kreativingenieuren, Designern, Vermarktern usw. zusammen, um Technologien zu entwerfen und zu entwickeln, die den Zugang zu den Informationen der Welt verbessern. Wir sind dafür verantwortlich, Produkte während des gesamten Ausführungszyklus zu führen, wobei wir uns speziell auf die Analyse, Positionierung, Verpackung, Förderung und Anpassung unserer Lösungen an unsere Benutzer konzentrieren.

In der KI-Ära erwarten die Benutzer, dass die Suche mühelos alles beantwortet, erforscht und anspricht. Um diesen steigenden Erwartungen gerecht zu werden, brauchen unsere Modelle den Inhalt.
Das Team der Search Content Platform (SCP) erstellt eine AI-First-Content-Plattform, um eine umfassende und vertrauenswürdige Wissensquelle bereitzustellen. Indem wir Daten von Drittanbietern erfassen und unterschiedliche Modalitäten wie Text, Bilder, Videos und benutzergenerierte Inhalte zu einem nahtlosen Ganzen organisieren, machen wir die KI-Erfahrungen in der Suche reich, hilfreich und performant.
Die Mission unseres Teams ist es, KI zu nutzen, um zu revolutionieren, wie wir Inhalte von Drittanbietern erwerben und organisieren. Als Group Product Manager für Content Acquisition and Identity leiten Sie ein Team, das die Zukunft von Google Search-Inhalten definiert. Sie arbeiten mit Ingenieurteams in Zürich, Sao Paulo und Mountain View zusammen und vertreten die Organisation als wichtige Partner.

In der Google-Suche überdenken wir, was es bedeutet, nach Informationen zu suchen - auf jede Weise und überall. Um dies zu erreichen, müssen wir komplexe technische Herausforderungen lösen und unsere Infrastruktur erweitern, während wir eine allgemein zugängliche und nützliche Erfahrung beibehalten, auf die sich Menschen auf der ganzen Welt verlassen. Wenn Sie dem Suchteam beitreten, haben Sie die Möglichkeit, Einfluss auf Milliarden von Menschen weltweit zu nehmen.

Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie das Produktziel, detaillierte Plattformanforderungen für eine horizontale Content-Akquisitionsplattform, die die Content-Akquisition von Drittanbietern (3P) beschleunigt und gleichzeitig wichtige Schwerpunkte wie Sport und Gesundheit erfüllt.

• Ermöglichen Sie der Suche, Milliarden von Benutzeranfragen täglich zu beantworten, indem Sie die Inhaltsidentität für die KI-Ära erneuern und klare, unklare und präzise Identitäten für Milliarden von Benutzeranfragen auf der Suche festlegen.

• Direkte Bemühungen, Milliarden von aktuellen und ambitionierten Benutzeranfragen zu analysieren, denen es an ausreichenden Inhalten mangelt, und Initiativen zu priorisieren oder voranzutreiben, um diese Lücken zu schließen und die Produkthilfsbereitschaft für Endbenutzer zu verbessern.

• Besprechen Sie Ihr Wissen und den Einsatz von KI-Tools während des Einstellungsprozesses, um die in dieser Rolle erwartete KI-Geläufigkeit zu demonstrieren.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Titres minimums:

• Baccalauréat ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 10 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de produits ou un rôle technique connexe.

• 5 ans d'expérience en prenant des produits techniques de la conception au lancement (par exemple, idée à l'exécution, bout à bout, 0 à 1, etc.).

• 5 ans d'expérience en gestion des personnes, avec un leadership technique.

• Expérimentez l'intégration d'outils d'IA génériques ou d'interfaces LLM dans les workflows.

Titres préférés:

• Expérience d'équilibrer la portée des consommateurs avec les contraintes d'infrastructure (coût, latence et optimisation des modèles).

• Expérience du leadership interfonctionnel et partenariat avec les équipes au-delà des frontières organisationnelles.

• Familiarité avec l'apprentissage machine moderne, les LLM et les modèles fondamentaux (tels que Gemini).

Sur le travail
Chez Google, nous mettons nos utilisateurs en premier. Le monde est en constante évolution, nous avons donc besoin de Product Managers qui s'adaptent continuellement et sont excités à travailler sur des produits qui affectent des millions de personnes chaque jour.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez interfonctionnellement pour guider les produits de la conception au lancement en reliant les mondes technique et commercial. Vous pouvez décomposer les problèmes complexes en étapes qui conduisent au développement de produits.

L'une des nombreuses raisons pour lesquelles Google apporte constamment des produits innovants et changeants sur le marché est le travail collaboratif que nous faisons dans la gestion des produits. Notre équipe travaille en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs créatifs, des concepteurs, des marketeurs, etc. pour aider à concevoir et développer des technologies qui améliorent l'accès à l'information mondiale. Nous sommes responsables de guider les produits tout au long du cycle d'exécution, en mettant l'accent sur l'analyse, le positionnement, l'emballage, la promotion et l'adaptation de nos solutions à nos utilisateurs.

À l'ère de l'IA, les utilisateurs s'attendent à ce que Search réponde sans effort, explore et adresse n'importe quoi. Pour répondre à ces attentes croissantes, nos modèles ont besoin du contenu.
L'équipe de Search Content Platform (SCP) construit une plateforme de premier contenu AI pour fournir une source de connaissances complète et fiable. En acquérant des données de tiers et en organisant des modalités disparates, comme le texte, les images, les vidéos et le contenu généré par l'utilisateur, nous rendons les expériences de recherche d'IA riches, utiles et performantes.
Notre équipe a pour mission d'utiliser l'IA pour révolutionner notre façon d'acquérir et d'organiser des contenus tiers. En tant que Group Product Manager pour l'acquisition de contenu et l'identité, vous gérerez une équipe pour définir l'avenir du contenu Google Search. Vous collaborerez avec des équipes d'ingénieurs à Zurich, Sao Paulo et Mountain View, et représenterez l'organisation auprès de partenaires clés.

Dans Google Search, nous réimaginons ce que cela signifie de rechercher des informations – de n'importe quelle façon et n'importe où. Pour ce faire, nous devons résoudre des problèmes complexes d'ingénierie et développer notre infrastructure, tout en maintenant une expérience universellement accessible et utile sur laquelle les gens du monde entier comptent. En rejoignant l'équipe de recherche, vous aurez l'occasion de faire un impact sur des milliards de personnes dans le monde.

Responsabilités

• Diriger l'objectif du produit, les exigences détaillées de plate-forme pour une plate-forme horizontale d'acquisition de contenu qui accélère l'acquisition de contenu par des tiers (3P) tout en exécutant des verticales prioritaires critiques comme le sport et la santé.

• Permettre à Search de répondre quotidiennement à des milliards de requêtes d'utilisateurs en innovant sur l'identité de contenu pour l'ère de l'IA et en établissant des identités claires, désambiguées et précises pour des milliards de requêtes d'utilisateurs sur Search quotidiennement.

• Des efforts directs sont déployés pour analyser des milliards de requêtes d'utilisateurs actuelles et aspirationnelles qui manquent de contenu suffisant et pour prioriser ou stimuler les initiatives visant à combler ces lacunes et à améliorer l'utilité des produits pour les utilisateurs finaux.

• Discutez de vos connaissances et de l'utilisation des outils d'IA au cours du processus d'embauche afin de démontrer la compétence en matière d'IA prévue dans ce rôle.

titleByLocale.it: Software Ingegnere, Search Ads in AI Experiences

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience with software development in C++ and Python.

• 3 years of experience with one or more of the following: deep learning, reinforcement learning, generative AI, or specialization in another ML field.

• 3 years of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging).

• 3 years of experience testing, maintaining, or launching software products, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

• 5 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Experience with machine learning, data science, statistics, natural language processing, computer vision, etc.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Ads Targeting team is responsible for one of the highest-priority initiatives at Google: reinventing Search Ads for the AI era (AI Overview, AI Mode). Our mission is to ensure that as Search experience evolves with AI, we unlock new ways for users to discover and engage with businesses through seamless, next-generation commercial experiences. We are a team of risk-takers and builders, responsible for experimenting with rapid velocity to define the next decade of Google’s revenue engine.

Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.
 Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.

Responsibilities

• Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.

• Perform model training, evaluation, and deployment to solve business-critical problems. This includes exploration of new model architectures, augmenting existing training data, finding better evaluation methods and feedback signals, and identifying headroom opportunities.

• Understand production systems, visualize, monitor, and optimize performance.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest tools and research in the field, working with our collaborators in Google Research and Deep Mind.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nella maggior parte dei casi, questa posizione richiede colloqui in presenza come parte del processo di assunzione.

Requisiti minimi:

• Laurea triennale o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software in C++ e Python.

• 3 anni di esperienza con uno o più dei seguenti argomenti: deep learning, reinforcement learning, IA generativa o specializzazione in un altro campo del ML.

• 3 anni di esperienza con infrastrutture ML (ad esempio, distribuzione di modelli, valutazione di modelli, elaborazione dati, debugging).

• 3 anni di esperienza nel test, manutenzione o lancio di prodotti software, e 1 anno di esperienza nella progettazione e architettura software.

Qualifiche preferite:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Informatica o in un campo tecnico correlato.

• 5 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• 1 anno di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica.

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di tecnologie accessibili.

• Esperienza con machine learning, data science, statistica, elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, computer vision, ecc.

Informazioni sul lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e tra loro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su larga scala e andare ben oltre la ricerca web. Cerchiamo ingegneri che portino idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui il recupero delle informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design UI e il mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google, con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business dinamico crescete ed evolvi. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, mostrino qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti nell'affrontare nuovi problemi nel full-stack mentre continuiamo a far progredire la tecnologia.

Il team Ads Targeting è responsabile di una delle iniziative di massima priorità di Google: reinventare gli annunci di ricerca per l'era dell'IA (AI Overview, AI Mode). La nostra missione è garantire che, man mano che l'esperienza di ricerca evolve con l'IA, sblocchiamo nuovi modi per gli utenti di scoprire e interagire con le aziende attraverso esperienze commerciali di nuova generazione senza soluzione di continuità. Siamo un team di persone che si assumono rischi e costruiscono il progetto, responsabile di sperimentare la rapidità per definire il prossimo decennio del motore di ricavi di Google.

Google Ads è all'avanguardia nell'innovazione nell'IA, applicando modelli di machine learning e IA generativa all'avanguardia come Gemini per alimentare un business globale da miliardi di dollari.
Il nostro lavoro impatta direttamente miliardi di utenti proteggendo gli utenti dai danni, migliorando la qualità degli annunci e ottimizzando le campagne per il ritorno sull'investimento degli inserzionisti. Promuoviamo una cultura di profonda collaborazione, collaborando strettamente con team come Google Research e DeepMind per risolvere sfide complesse. Unisciti a noi per lavorare su intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia, affrontare problemi su scala senza precedenti e costruire la prossima generazione di tecnologia pubblicitaria.

Responsabilità

• Progetti propri dall'inizio all'iniziale alla progettazione, analisi e implementazione.

• Eseguire addestramento, valutazione e distribuzione dei modelli per risolvere problemi critici per il business. Questo include l'esplorazione di nuove architetture di modelli, l'integrazione dei dati di addestramento esistenti, la ricerca di metodi di valutazione e segnali di feedback migliori e l'identificazione delle opportunità di headroom.

• Comprendere i sistemi di produzione, visualizzare, monitorare e ottimizzare le prestazioni.

• Rimani aggiornato con gli ultimi strumenti e ricerche nel settore, collaborando con i nostri collaboratori di Google Research e Deep Mind.

Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung in C++ und Python.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Deep Learning, Reinforcement Learning, generative KI oder Spezialisierung in einem anderen ML-Bereich.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung mit ML-Infrastruktur (z. B. Modellbereitstellung, Modellbewertung, Datenverarbeitung, Debugging).

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Testen, Warten oder Launch von Softwareprodukten und 1 Jahr Erfahrung im Softwaredesign und in der Architektur.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master- oder Promotionsabschluss in Informatik oder verwandtem technischem Fachgebiet.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen und Algorithmen.

• 1 Jahr Erfahrung in einer technischen Führungsrolle.

• Erfahrung in der Entwicklung barrierefreier Technologien.

• Erfahrung mit maschinellem Lernen, Data Science, Statistik, natürlicher Sprachverarbeitung, Computer Vision usw.

Über die Arbeit
Googles Softwareingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern sich verbinden, erkunden und miteinander interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Maßstab verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, darunter Informationsabruf, verteiltes Rechnen, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerke und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobilgeräte; die Liste ist immer weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Softwareingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen Projekt, das für Googles Bedürfnisse entscheidend ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure vielseitig, zeigen Führungsqualitäten und sind begeistert, neue Probleme im gesamten Fullstack anzugehen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Das Ads Targeting-Team ist verantwortlich für eine der vorrangigsten Initiativen bei Google: die Neugestaltung von Suchanzeigen für das KI-Zeitalter (KI-Übersicht, KI-Modus). Unsere Mission ist es, sicherzustellen, dass wir mit der Weiterentwicklung der Sucherfahrung mit KI neue Wege eröffnen, wie Nutzer Unternehmen durch nahtlose, next-generation-kommerzielle Erlebnisse entdecken und mit ihnen interagieren können. Wir sind ein Team von Risikoträgern und Entwicklern, das dafür verantwortlich ist, mit hoher Geschwindigkeit zu experimentieren, um das nächste Jahrzehnt der Google-Umsatz-Engine zu definieren.

Google Ads steht an der Spitze der KI-Innovation und setzt modernstes maschinelles Lernen und generative KI-Modelle wie Gemini ein, um ein milliardenschweres globales Unternehmen anzutreiben.
Unsere Arbeit wirkt sich direkt auf Milliarden von Nutzern aus, indem wir Nutzer vor Schaden schützen, die Anzeigenqualität verbessern und Kampagnen für die Rendite der Werbetreibenden optimieren. Wir fördern eine Kultur der tiefen Zusammenarbeit und arbeiten eng mit Teams wie Google Research und DeepMind zusammen, um komplexe Herausforderungen zu lösen. Schließen Sie sich uns an, um an modernster KI zu arbeiten, Probleme in unvergleichlichem Umfang anzugehen und die nächste Generation von Werbetechnologien aufzubauen.

Verantwortlichkeiten

• Eigene Projekte von Anfang bis Ende von der ersten Idee über Design, Analyse bis zur Umsetzung.

• Führen Sie Modelltraining, -bewertung und -bereitstellung durch, um geschäftskritische Probleme zu lösen. Dazu gehört die Erkundung neuer Modellarchitekturen, die Erweiterung bestehender Trainingsdaten, die Suche nach besseren Bewertungsmethoden und Feedback-Signalen sowie die Identifizierung von Headroom-Möglichkeiten.

• Verstehen Sie Produktionssysteme, visualisieren, überwachen und optimieren Sie die Leistung.

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit den neuesten Werkzeugen und Forschungsergebnissen auf diesem Gebiet und arbeiten Sie mit unseren Partnern in Google Research und Deep Mind zusammen.

À propos du travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la manière dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et entre eux. Nos produits doivent gérer l'information à grande échelle, et bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent des idées fraîches dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseau et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interfaces utilisateur et le mobile ; la liste continue et s'allonge chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour les besoins de Google, avec des opportunités de changer d'équipe et de projets, à mesure que vous et notre entreprise dynamique grandissez et évoluez. Nous avons besoin que nos ingénieurs soient polyvalents, fassent preuve de qualités de leadership et soient enthousiastes à l'idée de relever de nouveaux problèmes dans le full-stack alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Notre mission est de garantir qu'à mesure que l'expérience de recherche évolue grâce à l'IA, nous débloqueons de nouvelles façons pour les utilisateurs de découvrir et d'interagir avec les entreprises grâce à des expériences commerciales de nouvelle génération sans faille. Sur le travail
Comme les ambitions de Google, le travail d'un ingénieur logiciel va au-delà de la simple recherche. Les responsables de l'ingénierie logicielle ont non seulement l'expertise technique nécessaire pour prendre en charge les grands projets et en assurer la direction technique, mais ils gèrent également une équipe d'ingénieurs. Non seulement vous optimisez votre propre code, mais vous assurez que les ingénieurs sont en mesure d'optimiser le leur. En tant que gestionnaire d'ingénierie logicielle, vous gérez les objectifs de votre projet, contribuez à la stratégie des produits et aidez à développer votre équipe. Les équipes travaillent dans l'ensemble de l'entreprise, dans des domaines tels que la recherche d'information, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, la mise en réseau, la sécurité, la compression des données, la conception de l'interface utilisateur. Fonctionnant avec échelle et vitesse, nos ingénieurs logiciels exceptionnels ne font que commencer -- et en tant que manager, vous guidez le chemin.

Avec une expertise technique et de leadership, vous gérez des ingénieurs dans plusieurs équipes et lieux, un budget de produits important et supervisez le déploiement de projets à grande échelle sur plusieurs sites à l'échelle internationale.
L'équipe de base construit la base technique derrière Google produits phares. Nous sommes propriétaires et défenseurs des éléments de conception sous-jacents, des plateformes de développement, des composants de produits et de l'infrastructure chez Google. Ce sont les éléments essentiels pour des expériences excellentes, sûres et cohérentes pour nos utilisateurs et stimuler le rythme de l'innovation pour chaque développeur. Nous regardons les produits de Google pour construire des solutions centrales, briser les barrières techniques et renforcer les systèmes existants. En tant qu'équipe principale, nous avons un mandat et une occasion unique d'influer sur les décisions techniques importantes de l'entreprise. La rémunération individuelle est déterminée par des facteurs tels que les compétences professionnelles, l'expérience et les études ou la formation pertinentes.

n most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
 Responsibilities

• Write product or system development code.

• Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

• Review code developed by other developers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

• Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

• Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle verwalten Sie mit Ihrem technischen Fachwissen Projektprioritäten, Termine und Ergebnisse. Sie entwerfen, entwickeln, testen, implementieren, warten und verbessern Softwarelösungen. Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und eine Gemeinschaft aufbauen. Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Kraft zu geben, seine Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was er liebt, und sich dabei miteinander zu verbinden. An der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und grenzenloser Kreativität bewegen wir uns mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß - und das alles zusammen.

• Überprüfen Sie den von anderen Entwicklern entwickelten Code und geben Sie Feedback, um Best Practices sicherzustellen (z. B. Stilrichtlinien, Überprüfung des Codes, Genauigkeit, Testbarkeit und Effizienz).

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

• Experience designing, training, and deploying Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) or graph embedding models using frameworks such as PyTorch Geometric (PyG), JAX/Jraph, or TF-GNN.

Preferred qualifications:

• Ability to lead the Research and Development (R&D) and production of complex ML/Infra algorithms.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

Our mission is to research and develop production-ready, self-service ML tools, and to support Google product teams on deploying ML solutions.
 In this role, you will join a fast moving Applied ML group dedicated to bringing graph ML algorithms to solve industrial temporal and relational data problems in Google. You will drive end-to-end life cycle of new features (brainstorming, literature review, development, productionization) and helping product teams (internal and external) deploy models.

You will also be a key contributor in the GraphML for Google Systems cross-Product Area initiative, helping build a unified platform based on GNN and AI agents to monitor, optimize, and support core infrastructure across storage, networking, and compute.

Responsibilities

• Identify, develop and productionize GNN/ML methods driven by client feedback, team brainstorming, literature review and original research applied into the GraphFlow GNN library.

• Develop and productionize industrial GNN/ML models and infrastructure for the GraphML for Google Systems cross-Product Area initiative to build a unified GNN and AI agent system to support Google's Systems.

• Partner closely with product teams and research groups to translate business requirements into ML solutions.

• 3 years of experience specializing in a machine learning field (e.g., foundational models, ML infrastructure, reinforcement learning, or similar areas).

• 3 years of experience with end-to-end machine learning (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

Preferred qualifications:

• PhD (or industry research experience) in ML, AI or related technical fields.

• Experience in full-cycle development and productionization of machine learning systems.

• Experience in distilling and deploying production-grade LLMs.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Web Health team's mission is to build user trust by ensuring Google shows a helpful mix of websites across all Search traffic. We achieve this by owning the full ML lifecycle, from developing state-of-the-art models to deploying them directly across Web Ranking and GenAI surfaces.

We are looking for an ML engineer with a deep care for and understanding of the intricate interplay between data, algorithms, objectives and business impact.
In Google Search, we're reimagining what it means to search for information – any way and anywhere. To do that, we need to solve complex engineering challenges and expand our infrastructure, while maintaining a universally accessible and useful experience that people around the world rely on.  Responsibilities

• Collaborate with peers and stakeholders through design and code reviews to ensure best practices amongst available technologies (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency,)

• Improve the tooling and infra.

• Maintain or ablate other systems that provide similar data, re-directing the clients to Centerpiece.

• Implement GenAI solutions, utilize ML infrastructure, and contribute to data preparation, optimization, and performance enhancements.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience designing solutions that maintain or enhance the privacy posture of the organization by analyzing and assessing proposed engineering designs (e.g., product features, infrastructure systems) and influencing stakeholders.

• 2 years of experience applying privacy technologies (e.g., differential privacy, automated access management solutions, etc.), and customizing existing solutions and frameworks to meet organizational needs.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience balancing risks in ambiguous and complex situations with multiple stakeholders.

• Experience managing multiple high priority requests, while determining resource allocation (e.g., time, prioritization) to solve the problems in a fast-paced, changing organization.

• Code review experience in one or more programming languages.

• Knowledge of common regulatory frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA).

About the job
 Our Security team works to create and maintain the safest operating environment for Google's users and developers. Security Engineers work with network equipment and actively monitor our systems for attacks and intrusions. In this role, you will also work with software engineers to proactively identify and fix security flaws and vulnerabilities.

In this role, you will influence infrastructure, tools, and features that go into Android and Google's core products running on Android: Google’s open-source mobile operating system powering more than 3 billion devices worldwide. You’ll advocate for Android users by putting user privacy first and help uphold requirements related to regulations.
 Android is Google’s mobile operating system powering more than 3 billion devices worldwide. Android is about bringing computing to everyone in the world. We believe computing is a super power for good, enabling access to information, economic opportunity, productivity, connectivity between friends and family and more. We think everyone in the world should have access to the best computing has to offer. We provide the platform for original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and developers to build compelling computing devices (smartphones, tablets, TVs, wearables, etc) that run the best apps/services for everyone in the world.

Responsibilities

• Conduct technical and quantitative analysis to drive scalable, efficient, and data-driven privacy decision-making.

• Design, architect, and lead implementation of privacy-enhancing solutions alongside engineering teams.

• Conduct privacy impact assessment of a single product component, and determine how to bridge between data regulations, governance and practical engineering practices, and policy practices.

• Develop, maintain and publish design or technical documentation to drive consistency in privacy decisions and practices.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.
 Responsibilities

• Write product or system development code.

• Accelerate the deployment of our capabilities to support critical regulatory requirements and key customer engagements, including Google Cloud and DeepMind.

• Partner with cross-functional teams and product groups to seamlessly integrate data protection and policy enforcement components into core infrastructure.

• Build foundational building blocks and shared mechanisms that centralize policy enforcement logic across multiple products and systems.

• Enhance development flows by actively adopting and integrating AI technologies to reduce toil and tech debt, improve productivity, and improve our systems.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in software development.

• 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

• 5 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

• Experience in prompt engineering, or multi-agent systems.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

• 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

The Shopping Graph is Google's comprehensive dataset of commercial information, designed to power shopping experiences across all of Google, including Search, YouTube, Ads, and next-generation AI experiences (like the Gemini, AI Mode and AI Overviews).

The Data Acquisition team focuses on acquiring this high-quality commerce data. The team's vision is to make it effortless for merchants to submit and improve their product information, ensuring the Shopping Graph has extensive coverage and top-tier data quality.

As a Staff Software Engineer on the Feeds Features team, you will lead the technical direction, design, and execution of flagship Merchant Center experiences and be responsible for the systems that analyze, benchmark, and optimize billions of offers.

Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end technical designs and drive core implementation (clean code, scalable pipelines, robust inference/serving paths). Balance ambitious AI/ML capabilities with low latency, high throughput, and cost-efficient inference budgets.

• Provide strategic thought leadership, establish multi-quarter technical roadmaps, and manage high-ambiguity quality challenges. Mentor, guide, and elevate junior to mid-level engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, experimentation, and high velocity.

• Develop, test, and maintain code for software solutions supporting Google Merchant Center's data ingestion and feed management systems based on defined requirements.

• Apply standard and emerging Google tools, resources, and processes to solve familiar, predefined technical tasks efficiently.

• Utilize Large Language Models (LLMs) and Gemini to help build autoraters for evaluating product data quality and to automate testing workflows.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Requisiti minimi:

• Laurea triennale o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8 anni di esperienza nella programmazione in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin o Go.

• 5 anni di esperienza nei test e nel lancio di prodotti software.

• 3 anni di esperienza nel design e architettura del software.

• Esperienza nell'integrazione di strumenti di IA generativa o interfacce LLM nei flussi di lavoro.

Qualifiche preferite:

• Master o dottorato in Ingegneria, Informatica o in un campo tecnico correlato.

• 8 anni di esperienza con strutture dati/algoritmi.

• 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica nella guida dei team di progetto e nella definizione della direzione tecnica.

• 3 anni di esperienza nel lavoro in un'organizzazione complessa e a matrice che coinvolge progetti interfunzionali o interaziendali.

Informazioni sul lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano il modo in cui miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e tra loro. I nostri prodotti devono gestire le informazioni su larga scala e andare ben oltre la ricerca web. Cerchiamo ingegneri che portino idee fresche da tutti i settori, tra cui il recupero delle informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design UI e il mobile; la lista continua e cresce ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google, con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business dinamico crescete ed evolvi. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, mostrino qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti nell'affrontare nuovi problemi nel full-stack mentre continuiamo a far progredire la tecnologia.

Il Shopping Graph è il dataset completo di informazioni commerciali di Google. Alimenta le esperienze di acquisto su tutto Google, inclusi Search, YouTube, Ads e esperienze AI di nuova generazione come Gemini e AI Overviews. Il team Data Acquisition è responsabile dell'acquisizione di questi dati di commercio di alta qualità. La nostra visione è rendere facile per i commercianti inviare e migliorare le informazioni sui loro prodotti, assicurando che il Shopping Graph mantenga una copertura estesa e una qualità dei dati.
Come pilastro fondamentale nell'acquisizione dati, il team Feeds Infra costruisce e possiede l'infrastruttura fondamentale che inserisce i dati nel Shopping Graph tramite file, API e web crawling. Oltre all'ingestione, consentiamo ai commercianti e ai team downstream di migliorare continuamente la qualità dei dati dei prodotti, soddisfacendo le richieste rigorose e l'asticella crescente dell'Agentic Commerce.

Le persone acquistano su Google più di un miliardo di volte al giorno - e il team Commerce è responsabile di costruire le esperienze che servono questi utenti. La missione di Google Commerce è essere una parte essenziale del percorso di acquisto per i consumatori - dall'ispirazione a un'esperienza di pagamento semplice e sicura - e il luogo migliore per rivenditori/commercianti per connettersi con i consumatori. Supportiamo e collaboriamo con l'ecosistema del commercio, dai grandi rivenditori ai piccoli commercianti locali, per fornire loro strumenti, tecnologia e scala per prosperare nel mondo digitale di oggi.

Responsabilità

• Fornire leadership tecnica su progetti ad alto impatto.

• Influenzare e allenare un team distribuito di ingegneri.

• Facilita l'allineamento e la chiarezza tra i team su obiettivi, risultati e tempistiche.

• Gestire priorità di progetto, scadenze e deliverable.

• Progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare soluzioni software su larga scala.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelor-Abschluss oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung im Programmieren in C++, Java, Python, Kotlin oder Go.

• 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Testen und Launch von Softwareprodukten.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Softwaredesign und in der Architektur.

• Erfahrung darin, generative KI-Tools oder LLM-Schnittstellen in Workflows zu integrieren.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master- oder PhD-Abschluss in Ingenieurwesen, Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Fachgebiet.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen/Algorithmen.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer technischen Führungsrolle, in der ich Projektteams leitete und die technische Richtung festlegte.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung in einer komplexen, matrixierten Organisation mit funktionsübergreifenden oder geschäftsübergreifenden Projekten.

Über die Arbeit
Googles Softwareingenieure entwickeln die Technologien der nächsten Generation, die verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern sich verbinden, erkunden und miteinander interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Maßstab verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, darunter Informationsabruf, verteiltes Rechnen, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerke und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, UI-Design und Mobilgeräte; die Liste ist immer weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Softwareingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem spezifischen Projekt, das für Googles Bedürfnisse entscheidend ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure vielseitig, zeigen Führungsqualitäten und sind begeistert, neue Probleme im gesamten Fullstack anzugehen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Der Shopping Graph ist Googles umfassender Datensatz mit kommerziellen Informationen. Er ermöglicht Einkaufserlebnisse in ganz Google, einschließlich Suche, YouTube, Werbung und Next-Generation-KI-Erlebnisse wie Gemini und KI-Übersichten. Das Data Acquisition-Team ist verantwortlich für die Beschaffung dieser hochwertigen Handelsdaten. Unsere Vision ist es, es Händlern mühelos zu machen, ihre Produktinformationen einzureichen und zu verbessern, damit der Shopping Graph eine umfassende Abdeckung und Datenqualität gewährleistet.
Als Kernpfeiler innerhalb der Datenerfassung baut und besitzt das Feeds Infra Team die grundlegende Infrastruktur, die Daten über Dateien, APIs und Webcrawling in den Shopping Graph einführt. Über die Aufnahme hinaus befähigen wir Händler und nachgelagerte Teams, die Qualität der Produktdaten kontinuierlich zu verbessern und die anspruchsvollen Anforderungen und die steigenden Anforderungen des Agentic Commerce zu erfüllen.

Menschen kaufen täglich mehr als eine Milliarde Mal bei Google ein – und das Commerce-Team ist dafür verantwortlich, die Erlebnisse zu schaffen, die diesen Nutzern dienen. Die Mission von Google Commerce ist es, ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der Einkaufsreise für Verbraucher zu sein – von der Inspiration bis hin zu einem einfachen und sicheren Checkout-Erlebnis – und der beste Ort für Einzelhändler/Händler, um mit Verbrauchern in Kontakt zu treten. Wir unterstützen und arbeiten mit dem Commerce-Ökosystem zusammen, von großen Einzelhändlern bis zu kleinen lokalen Händlern, um ihnen die Werkzeuge, Technologie und Skalierbarkeit an die Hand zu geben, um in der heutigen digitalen Welt erfolgreich zu sein.

Verantwortlichkeiten

• Technische Führung bei hochwirksamen Projekten bieten.

• Ein verteiltes Team von Ingenieuren zu beeinflussen und zu coachen.

• Fördern Sie die Ausrichtung und Klarheit zwischen Teams hinweg bei Zielen, Ergebnissen und Zeitplänen.

• Verwalten Sie Projektprioritäten, Fristen und Lieferergebnisse.

• Entwerfen, entwickeln, testen, bereitstellen, warten und verbessern groß angelegte Softwarelösungen.

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de nouvelle génération qui changent la manière dont des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et entre eux. Nos produits doivent gérer l'information à grande échelle, et bien au-delà de la recherche web. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour les besoins de Google, avec des opportunités de changer d'équipe et de projets, à mesure que vous et notre entreprise dynamique grandissez et évoluez. Nous avons besoin que nos ingénieurs soient polyvalents, fassent preuve de qualités de leadership et soient enthousiastes à l'idée de relever de nouveaux problèmes dans le full-stack alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Le Shopping Graph est le jeu de données complet d'informations commerciales de Google. jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience in product design or UX.

• 5 years of experience leading design projects and managing people or teams.

• 3 years of work experience working with executive leaders.

• Include a portfolio, website, or any other relevant link to your work in your resume (providing a viewable link or access instructions).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 7 years of experience working in a complex, cross-functional organization.

About the job
 At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a UX Design Manager, you will drive this vision by defining product strategy, mitigating complexity, and conceptualizing ecosystem-level UX. You are a systems-level thinker and a fierce advocate for both your users and your team.

You will be responsible for guiding the careers of your direct reports, helping them realize their full potential while fostering a culture of forward-thinking design. With a practiced eye for quality, you will transform complex workflows into elegantly simple experiences. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Product Management leaders to align business goals with design innovation, leveraging your passion for brand, craft, and execution.

User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”
 Responsibilities

• Drive the long-term User Experience (UX) goal for YouTube Studio and Creator Support, ensuring alignment across YouTube.

• Lead and mentor a high-performing, multi-disciplinary UX team across Zurich and Bangalore, fostering a collaborative culture.

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Research, and Content Design to influence stakeholders and align regional strategies.

• Advocate for scalable design systems while leveraging AI capabilities to enhance creator workflows and experience consistency.

• Maintain high visual and interaction quality standards while making informed product decisions grounded in creator needs.

A Google, "Focus sull'utente e tutto il resto seguirà". Ci sforziamo di imparare e comprendere le esigenze, i comportamenti e le emozioni dei nostri utenti per raccogliere informazioni che informano la strategia e il design del prodotto. I nostri team UX includono designer, ricercatori, strateghi dei contenuti e ingegneri che sono appassionati di qualità, usabilità e semplicità. Lavoriamo su team collaborativi per risolvere complesse sfide e esperienze artigianali che evidenziano le capacità e le personalità uniche dei nostri prodotti. Il nostro lavoro tocca miliardi esemplifica un principio chiave che è fondamentale per la filosofia di Google: “Focus sull’utente e tutto il resto seguirà”.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

About the job
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a UX Design Manager, you will drive this vision by defining product strategy, mitigating complexity, and conceptualizing ecosystem-level UX. You are a systems-level thinker and a fierce advocate for both your users and your team.

You will be responsible for guiding the careers of your direct reports, helping them realize their full potential while fostering a culture of forward-thinking design. With a practiced eye for quality, you will transform complex workflows into elegantly simple experiences. You will collaborate closely with Engineering and Product Management leaders to align business goals with design innovation, leveraging your passion for brand, craft, and execution.

User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”

• Lead and mentor a high-performing, multi-disciplinary UX team across Zurich and Bangalore, fostering a collaborative culture.

• Advocate for scalable design systems while leveraging AI capabilities to enhance creator workflows and experience consistency.

• Maintain high visual and interaction quality standards while making informed product decisions grounded in creator needs.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.

• 3 years of experience in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.

• 2 years of experience leading projects and providing technical leadership.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

About the job
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.

Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
 Responsibilities

• Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design, through to deployment, operation and refinement.

• Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.

• Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.

• Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.

• Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nella maggior parte dei casi, questa posizione richiede colloqui in presenza come parte del processo di assunzione.

Requisiti minimi:

• Laurea triennale in Informatica, in un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione.

• 3 anni di esperienza nella progettazione, analisi e risoluzione di problemi di sistemi distribuiti su larga scala.

• 2 anni di esperienza nella guida di progetti e nella leadership tecnica.

Qualifiche preferite:

• Master in Informatica o Ingegneria.

Informazioni sul lavoro
L'Ingegneria dell'Affidabilità del Sito (SRE) combina software e ingegneria dei sistemi per costruire e gestire sistemi su larga scala, distribuiti in modo massiccio e tolleranti ai guasti. SRE garantisce che i servizi di Google Cloud—sia quelli internamente critici che quelli visibili esternamente—abbiano affidabilità, tempo di attività adeguato alle esigenze dei clienti e un rapido ritmo di miglioramento. Inoltre, gli SRE terranno un controllo costante sulla capacità e le prestazioni dei nostri sistemi.

Gran parte del nostro sviluppo software si concentra sull'ottimizzazione dei sistemi esistenti, la costruzione di infrastrutture e l'eliminazione del lavoro tramite automazione. Nel team SRE, avrai l'opportunità di gestire le complesse sfide di scala che sono uniche di Google Cloud, utilizzando la tua esperienza in programmazione, algoritmi, analisi della complessità e progettazione di sistemi su larga scala. La cultura di SRE basata sulla curiosità intellettuale, la risoluzione dei problemi e l'apertura è fondamentale per il suo successo. La nostra organizzazione riunisce persone con una grande varietà di background, esperienze e prospettive. Le incoraggiamo a collaborare, pensare in grande e correre rischi in un ambiente senza colpe. Promuoviamo l'autodirezione per lavorare su progetti significativi, cercando anche di creare un ambiente che offra il supporto e la mentorship necessari per imparare e crescere.
Dietro tutto ciò che i nostri utenti vedono online c'è l'architettura costruita dal team Infrastruttura Tecnica per mantenerla in funzione. Dallo sviluppo e la manutenzione dei nostri data center alla costruzione della prossima generazione di piattaforme Google, rendiamo possibile il portafoglio prodotti di Google. Siamo orgogliosi di essere gli ingegneri dei nostri ingegneri e amiamo annullare le garanzie smontando le cose per poterle ricostruire. Manteniamo le nostre reti operative, assicurandoci che i nostri utenti abbiano la migliore e più veloce esperienza possibile.
Responsabilità

• Impegnarsi e migliorare l'intero ciclo di vita dei servizi—dall'inizio e progettazione, fino al deployment, all'operatività e al perfezionamento.

• Servizi di supporto prima che vengano attivati attraverso attività come consulenza per la progettazione di sistemi, sviluppo di piattaforme e framework software, pianificazione delle capacità e revisioni di lancio.

• Mantenere i servizi una volta attivi misurando e monitorando la disponibilità, la latenza e la salute complessiva del sistema.

• Scalare i sistemi in modo sostenibile attraverso meccanismi come l'automazione, ed evolverli spingendo per cambiamenti che migliorino affidabilità e velocità.

• Pratica una risposta sostenibile agli incidenti e post-mortem senza colpe.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Masterabschluss in Informatik oder Ingenieurwesen.

Über die Arbeit
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) kombiniert Software- und Systemtechnik, um groß angelegte, massiv verteilte, fehlertolerante Systeme zu bauen und zu betreiben. SRE stellt sicher, dass die Dienste von Google Cloud – sowohl unsere intern kritischen als auch unsere extern sichtbaren Systeme – Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit und eine schnelle Verbesserungsrate besitzen. Darüber hinaus werden SREs die Kapazität und Leistung unserer Systeme stets genau beobachten.

Ein Großteil unserer Softwareentwicklung konzentriert sich auf die Optimierung bestehender Systeme, den Aufbau von Infrastruktur und die Beseitigung von Arbeit durch Automatisierung. Im SRE-Team haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die komplexen Skalierungsherausforderungen, die für Google Cloud einzigartig sind, zu bewältigen und dabei Ihre Expertise in Programmierung, Algorithmen, Komplexitätsanalyse und groß angelegtem Systemdesign zu nutzen. Die Kultur von SRE aus intellektueller Neugier, Problemlösung und Offenheit ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Unsere Organisation bringt Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Wir ermutigen sie, zusammenzuarbeiten, groß zu denken und Risiken in einer schuldfreien Umgebung einzugehen. Wir fördern Selbststeuerung bei der Arbeit an sinnvollen Projekten und bemühen uns zugleich, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, das die Unterstützung und Mentoring bietet, die zum Lernen und Wachsen notwendig sind.
Hinter allem, was unsere Nutzer online sehen, steht die vom Technical Infrastructure-Team entwickelte Architektur, um sie am Laufen zu halten. Von der Entwicklung und Wartung unserer Rechenzentren bis hin zur Entwicklung der nächsten Generation von Google-Plattformen machen wir das Produktportfolio von Google möglich. Wir sind stolz darauf, die Ingenieure unserer Ingenieure zu sein, und lieben es, Garantien zu erlöschen, indem wir Dinge auseinandernehmen, um sie wieder aufzubauen. Wir halten unsere Netzwerke am Laufen und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Nutzer das bestmögliche und schnellste Erlebnis haben.
Verantwortlichkeiten

• Beteiligen Sie sich an und verbessern Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus von Dienstleistungen – von der Entstehung und dem Design bis hin zur Bereitstellung, dem Betrieb und der Verfeinerung.

• Unterstützungsdienste, bevor sie live gehen, durch Aktivitäten wie Systemdesignberatung, Entwicklung von Softwareplattformen und Frameworks, Kapazitätsplanung und Launch-Reviews.

• Pflegen Sie die Dienste, sobald sie live sind, indem Sie Verfügbarkeit, Latenz und den allgemeinen Systemzustand messen und überwachen.

• Skalieren Sie Systeme nachhaltig durch Mechanismen wie Automatisierung und entwickeln Sie Systeme, indem Sie Veränderungen vorantreiben, die Zuverlässigkeit und Geschwindigkeit verbessern.

• Praktiziere nachhaltige Vorfallreaktion und unschuldige Nachbeurteilungen.
