In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 10 years of experience managing or leading multi-layered technical organizations.

• 3 years of experience in people management.

• Experience with technical delivery strategies and interfacing with product or engineering organizations.

• Experience with enterprise integrations (APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), Cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.

• Experience driving cloud transformations for enterprise-level clients.

Preferred qualifications:

• 15 years of experience in enterprise customer success, technical delivery, consulting, or IT operations leadership.

• Experience building business cases and articulating the Return on Investment (ROI) of technology investments to executive stakeholders.

• Prior experience leading a professional services or consulting organization at a global hyperscale provider (Google Cloud).

• Communication skills with a proven ability to influence at the CEO/CTO level.

• Demonstrated success in managing complex commercial dynamics, including strategies and technical risk mitigation for portfolios exceeding $500M+ in cloud spend.

• History of driving innovation in service delivery, such as integrating AI-driven insights into customer delivery model.

About the job
 The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Manager of AI Outcome Customer Engineering (AIOCE) for the North region, you will lead the strategic goal and execution for a team of AIOCEs. You will lead a highly specialized team of technical experts dedicated to helping customers fully realize the value of Gemini Enterprise (GE) . You will oversee the technical execution and business operations required to accelerate customer adoption and decrease the time to first production value.
 In this role, you will act as a central orchestration leader, building critical alliances with customer executives, and internal go-to-market leadership, to ensure complex workloads transition seamlessly from agreement signing to full production. Beyond technical delivery, you will be a dedicated people leader tasked with cultivating a mission-first culture, developing top talent, and strategically driving AI transformation across your organization.
 Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Responsibilities

• Define and execute the AIOCE engagement and adoption strategy. Act as a trusted advisor to C-suite stakeholders, establishing scalable and repeatable frameworks to accelerate onboarding, mitigate risks, and drive long-term AI transformation across the portfolio.

• Manage the end-to-end AI transformation journey by orchestrating alliances across sales, product, engineering, Google Cloud Consulting, and external partners. Serve as a strategic escalation point to allocate resources and ensure the timely delivery of high-complexity deployments.

• Define and execute Cloud AI adoption processes and frameworks that ensure rapid customer onboarding and large-scale adoption.

• Hire, develop, and lead a high-performing technical team, making strategic talent decisions regarding to scale the AIOCE organization.

• Represent regional Google Cloud Product and Engineering teams, translating customer trends, technical gaps, and adoption challenges into actionable requirements that influence future product roadmaps.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience with security assessments or security design reviews or threat modeling.

• 5 years of experience with security engineering, computer and network security and security protocols.

• 5 years of coding experience in one or more general purpose languages.

• 1 year of experience leading teams in a technical capacity or leading technical risk analysis in an enterprise environment.

Preferred qualifications:

• 2 years of experience in a threat intelligence, incident response, security operations center, or highly related analyst role.

• Experience in detection engineering with YARA, Snort/Suricata, EDR rule creation.

• Experience in Python, C/C++, or scripting languages.

• Experience in reverse engineering.

• Strong understanding of network fundamentals, techniques for lateral machine movement, malware persistence mechanisms, covert channels, application security and user authentication, command and control techniques.

• Strong communication and documentation skills.

About the job
Part of Google Cloud, Mandiant is a recognized leader in dynamic cyber defense, threat intelligence and incident response services. Mandiant's cybersecurity expertise has earned the trust of security professionals and company executives around the world. Our unique combination of renowned frontline experience responding to some of the most complex breaches, nation-state grade threat intelligence, machine intelligence, and the industry's best security validation ensures that Mandiant knows more about today's advanced threats than anyone.
 Responsibilities

• Identify, analyze, and document network signals, malware behaviors, and threat reports related to trends and developments in adversary tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).

• Provide clear, actionable, and structured intelligence to product and security teams. Assist in ensuring corporate and production systems are safeguarded.

• Own the analysis efforts of multiple threat actors, and serve as a subject matter expert on how those actors might impact Google and our users.

• Enhance analysis efficiency by conceiving and implementing automation opportunities, developing proof-of-concept code, and collaborating with stakeholders to deploy solutions.

• Be capable of quickly identifying personal and team priorities, and able to work on assignments with minimal supervision while maintaining quality and deadlines.

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza con l'ingegneria della sicurezza, i protocolli di sicurezza e sicurezza del computer e della rete.

• 5 anni di esperienza di codifica in una o più lingue di scopo generale.

• 1 anno di esperienza leader team in una capacità tecnica o leader analisi di rischio tecnico in un ambiente aziendale.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• 2 anni di esperienza in un'intelligenza di minaccia, risposta agli incidenti, centro di operazioni di sicurezza, o ruolo di analista altamente correlati.

• Esperienza nell'ingegneria di rilevamento con YARA, Snort/Suricata, creazione di regole EDR.

• Esperienza in Python, C/C++ o linguaggi di scrittura.

• Esperienza in reverse engineering.

• Forte comprensione dei fondamenti di rete, tecniche per il movimento laterale della macchina, meccanismi di persistenza malware, canali nascosti, sicurezza delle applicazioni e autenticazione degli utenti, tecniche di comando e controllo.

• Forte capacità di comunicazione e documentazione.

Riguardo al lavoro
Parte di Google Cloud, Mandiant è un leader riconosciuto nei servizi di difesa informatica dinamica, intelligenza delle minacce e risposta agli incidenti. Le competenze di sicurezza informatica di Mandiant hanno guadagnato la fiducia di professionisti della sicurezza e dirigenti aziendali in tutto il mondo. La nostra combinazione unica di esperienza di fronte rinomato che risponde ad alcune delle violazioni più complesse, l'intelligenza di minaccia di livello nazionale-stato, l'intelligenza della macchina e la migliore validazione di sicurezza del settore assicura che Mandiant conosce più sulle minacce avanzate di oggi di chiunque altro.
responsabilità

• Identificare, analizzare e documentare i segnali di rete, i comportamenti di malware e i rapporti di minaccia relativi a tendenze e sviluppi in tattiche, tecniche e procedure avversarie (TTP).

• Fornire informazioni chiare, attuabili e strutturate ai team di prodotto e sicurezza. Assistere a garantire la sicurezza dei sistemi aziendali e produttivi.

• Possedere gli sforzi di analisi di più attori di minaccia, e servire come esperto di materia tema su come tali attori potrebbero influenzare Google e i nostri utenti.

• Migliorare l'efficienza dell'analisi conceiving e implementando opportunità di automazione, lo sviluppo di codice di prova di concetto e la collaborazione con gli stakeholder per implementare soluzioni.

• Essere in grado di identificare rapidamente le priorità personali e di squadra, e in grado di lavorare su incarichi con supervisione minima, mantenendo la qualità e le scadenze.

• Verbessern Sie die Analyseeffizienz durch die Konzeption und Implementierung von Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten, die Entwicklung von Proof-of-Concept-Code und die Zusammenarbeit mit Stakeholdern bei der Bereitstellung von Lösungen.

• In der Lage sein, persönliche und Teamprioritäten schnell zu identifizieren und Aufgaben mit minimaler Aufsicht zu bearbeiten, während Qualität und Termine eingehalten werden.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in C++ and Python, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 1 year of experience with ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, optimization, data processing, debugging).

• 1 year of experience with one or more of the following: LLM systems, Speech/audio (e.g., technology duplicating and responding to the human voice), reinforcement learning (e.g., sequential decision making), ML infrastructure, or specialization in another ML field.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures or algorithms.

• Experience with B2C or e-commerce software.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In YouTube Shopping Creator, we leverage advanced infrastructure to empower creators in producing high-quality, shopping-enabled content. A key business priority is expanding the creator and shopping content and driving active engagement with shopping features. Our mission is to enable creators to launch and scale their Shopping journey through seamless activation, intelligent matchmaking, and data-motivated inspiration. As a team, we drive growth by owning the Activation and Inspiration CUJs. We focus on expanding eligibility and improving retention through a staged framework. Beyond onboarding, we create and leverage Creator Profiles and Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) predictive modeling to provide actionable insights, helping creators discover the best merchants, lucrative offers, and relevant products for their audience.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.
 Responsibilities

• Lead the design and development of innovative ML/AI-driven models and features.

• Architect and build systems that deeply integrate LLMs and other AI technologies to provide intelligent recommendations.

• Drive integrations across multiple product partners; lead by strong collaborations and partnerships.

• Collaborate closely with Product Managers, UX Designers, Data Scientists, and other engineering teams to define and deliver the roadmap for ML/AI capabilities.

• 2 anni di esperienza con strutture dati o algoritmi.

• Esperienza con software B2C o e-commerce.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con le opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

In YouTube Shopping Creator, possiamo sfruttare l'infrastruttura avanzata per consentire ai creatori di produrre contenuti di alta qualità e di alta qualità. Una priorità di business chiave sta espandendo il contenuto del creatore e dello shopping e di guidare il coinvolgimento attivo con le caratteristiche dello shopping. La nostra missione è quella di consentire ai creatori di lanciare e scalare il loro viaggio Shopping attraverso l'attivazione senza soluzione di continuità, il matchmaking intelligente e l'ispirazione data-motivated. Come squadra, guidiamo la crescita possedendo i CUJ di Attivazione e Ispirazione. Ci concentriamo sull'espansione dell'ammissibilità e sul miglioramento della ritenzione attraverso un quadro organizzato. Oltre a salire a bordo, creiamo e leviamo Profili Creatori e Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning (AI/ML) modelli predittivi per fornire intuizioni attuabili, aiutando i creatori a scoprire i migliori commercianti, offerte lucrative e prodotti rilevanti per il loro pubblico. Su YouTube, crediamo che tutti meritino di avere una voce, e che il mondo è un posto migliore quando ascoltiamo, condividiamo e costruiamo la comunità attraverso le nostre storie. Lavoriamo insieme per dare a tutti il potere di condividere la loro storia, esplorare ciò che amano, e connettersi tra loro nel processo. Lavorando all'incrocio tra tecnologia all'avanguardia e creatività senza limiti, ci muoviamo alla velocità della cultura con un obiettivo comune per mostrare alle persone il mondo. Esploriamo nuove idee, risolviamo problemi reali, e divertiamo — e lo facciamo tutti insieme.
responsabilità

• Guida il design e lo sviluppo di innovativi modelli e caratteristiche ML/AI-driven.

• Architettare e costruire sistemi che integrano profondamente LLM e altre tecnologie AI per fornire raccomandazioni intelligenti.

• Integrazioni di guida attraverso più partner di prodotto; guidate da forti collaborazioni e partnership.

• Collabora a stretto contatto con Product Manager, UX Designers, Data Scientists e altri team di ingegneria per definire e fornire la roadmap per le capacità ML/AI.

B. sequentielle Entscheidungsfindung), ML-Infrastruktur oder Spezialisierung in einem anderen ML-Bereich.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik oder verwandten technischen Bereichen.

• 2 Jahre Erfahrung mit Datenstrukturen oder Algorithmen.

• Erfahrung mit B2C oder E-Commerce-Software.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern Informationen miteinander verbinden, erforschen und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In YouTube Shopping Creator nutzen wir fortschrittliche Infrastruktur, um Schöpfer in die Lage zu versetzen, qualitativ hochwertige, einkaufsfähige Inhalte zu produzieren. Eine wichtige Geschäftspriorität besteht darin, den Ersteller und den Einkaufsinhalt zu erweitern und die aktive Interaktion mit Einkaufsfunktionen voranzutreiben. Unsere mission ist es, schöpfern zu ermöglichen, ihre shopping-reise durch nahtlose aktivierung, intelligentes matchmaking und datenmotivierte inspiration zu starten und zu skalieren. Als Team treiben wir das Wachstum voran, indem wir die Aktivierungs- und Inspirations-CUJs besitzen. Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Erweiterung der Förderfähigkeit und die Verbesserung der Bindung durch einen gestaffelten Rahmen. Über das Onboarding hinaus erstellen und nutzen wir Creator-Profile und prädiktive KI/ML-Modellierung (Künstliche Intelligenz/Maschinenlernen), um umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu liefern und Schöpfern dabei zu helfen, die besten Händler, lukrativen Angebote und relevanten Produkte für ihr Publikum zu entdecken. Bei YouTube glauben wir, dass jeder eine Stimme verdient und dass die Welt ein besserer Ort ist, wenn wir durch unsere Geschichten zuhören, teilen und eine Gemeinschaft aufbauen. Wir arbeiten zusammen, um jedem die Kraft zu geben, seine Geschichte zu teilen, zu erforschen, was er liebt, und sich dabei miteinander zu verbinden. An der Schnittstelle von Spitzentechnologie und grenzenloser Kreativität bewegen wir uns mit der Geschwindigkeit der Kultur mit dem gemeinsamen Ziel, den Menschen die Welt zu zeigen. Wir erforschen neue Ideen, lösen echte Probleme und haben Spaß - und das alles zusammen.
Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie das Design und die Entwicklung innovativer ML / AI-basierter Modelle und Funktionen.

• Architektur und Bau von Systemen, die LLMs und andere KI-Technologien tief integrieren, um intelligente Empfehlungen zu geben.

• Fördern Sie Integrationen über mehrere Produktpartner hinweg; führen Sie durch starke Kooperationen und Partnerschaften.

• Arbeiten Sie eng mit Produktmanagern, UX-Designern, Data Scientists und anderen Engineering-Teams zusammen, um die Roadmap für ML / AI-Funktionen zu definieren und bereitzustellen.

Sur le travail
Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nos produits doivent traiter l'information à grande échelle, et s'étendre bien au-delà de la recherche web. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour les besoins de Google avec des occasions de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. Nous avons besoin de nos ingénieurs pour être polyvalents, faire preuve de qualités de leadership et être enthousiastes à affronter de nouveaux problèmes à travers la pile pleine alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie.

Dans YouTube Shopping Creator, nous mettons à profit l'infrastructure avancée pour donner aux créateurs les moyens de produire des contenus de haute qualité, compatibles avec le shopping. L'une des principales priorités de l'entreprise est d'élargir le contenu du créateur et du magasinage et de stimuler l'engagement actif avec les fonctionnalités du magasinage. Notre mission est de permettre aux créateurs de lancer et d'élargir leur parcours d'achat grâce à une activation transparente, à des matchmakings intelligents et à une inspiration fondée sur les données. En équipe, nous favorisons la croissance en possédant les CUJs d'Activation et d'Inspiration. Nous nous concentrons sur l'élargissement de l'admissibilité et l'amélioration du maintien en poste grâce à un cadre par étapes. Au-delà de l'embarquement, nous créons et mettons à profit les profils du créateur et la modélisation prédictive de l'intelligence artificielle et de l'apprentissage de la machine (AI/ML) pour fournir des renseignements concrets, aider les créateurs à découvrir les meilleurs marchands, des offres lucratives et des produits pertinents pour leur public. Sur YouTube, nous croyons que tout le monde mérite d'avoir une voix, et que le monde est un meilleur endroit lorsque nous écoutons, partageons et construisons la communauté à travers nos histoires. Nous travaillons ensemble pour donner à chacun le pouvoir de partager son histoire, d'explorer ce qu'il aime et de se connecter dans le processus. Travaillant à l'intersection d'une technologie de pointe et d'une créativité illimitée, nous agissons à la vitesse de la culture avec un objectif commun de montrer aux gens le monde. Nous explorons de nouvelles idées, résolvons de vrais problèmes et nous nous amusons — et nous le faisons tous ensemble.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process

Minimum qualifications:

• Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• 8 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 6 years of experience with a PhD degree.

• Experience building, managing, and leading teams of data scientists or quantitative researchers.

• Experience applying experiment design, regression analysis, and core statistics to perform data analysis that drives business analysis and decision-making.

Preferred qualifications:

• 10 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 8 years of experience with a PhD degree.

• Experience in modern statistical theory, including experiment design, regression models, causal inference, sampling methods, time-series analysis, and hierarchical modeling.

• Strong data intuition and business acumen, with the experience in data analysis to solve business problems in complex, fast-moving, and ambiguous business environments.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex investigative findings for executive stakeholders.

About the job
The Ads Metrics team is the core data science team behind Google Search Ads. We develop mechanisms, experiment designs, evaluation metrics, statistical methods, and analysis libraries to help build the next generation of our Search advertising products.

As a Data Scientist in the Ads Metrics team, you will collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, researchers, and analysts to push the boundaries of experiment design, causal inference, and time-series analysis for business-critical launches.
Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.
 Responsibilities

• Lead and manage a high-performing subteam of data scientists in the area of Search Ads Targeting.

• Collaborate with our engineering and product partners to identify key questions to answer. Translate and refine business questions into appropriate experiments, analyses, evaluation metrics, or mathematical models.

• Architect end-to-end analysis pipelines, translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous frameworks and statistical models.

• Design and evaluate complex experiments or models (e.g., causal inference, hierarchical models) to solve problems with limited precedent in retrieval and ranking.

• Translate massive-scale system telemetry into statistically sound evidence, ensuring the highest standards of data integrity for research-grade analysis that unblocks billion-dollar launches.

Titolo minimo:

• Laurea magistrale in Statistica, Scienza dei dati, Matematica, Fisica, Economia, Operazioni di ricerca, Ingegneria, o un campo quantitativo relativo.

• 8 anni di esperienza utilizzando analisi per risolvere problemi di prodotto o di business, codifica (ad esempio, Python, R, SQL), querying database o analisi statistica, o 6 anni di esperienza con un dottorato di ricerca.

• Sperimenta la costruzione, la gestione e i principali team di scienziati di dati o ricercatori quantitativi.

• Esperienza nell'applicazione della progettazione degli esperimenti, dell'analisi della regressione e delle statistiche fondamentali per eseguire l'analisi dei dati che guida l'analisi aziendale e il processo decisionale.

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• 10 anni di esperienza utilizzando analisi per risolvere problemi di prodotto o di business, codifica (ad esempio, Python, R, SQL), querying database o analisi statistica, o 8 anni di esperienza con un dottorato di ricerca.

• Esperienza nella moderna teoria statistica, tra cui progettazione di esperimenti, modelli di regressione, inferenza causale, metodi di campionamento, analisi di serie temporali e modellazione gerarchica.

• Forte intuito dei dati e acume aziendale, con l'esperienza nell'analisi dei dati per risolvere i problemi aziendali in ambienti aziendali complessi, in rapida evoluzione e ambigui.

• Ottima capacità di comunicazione e presentazione, con la capacità di distillare complessi risultati investigativi per gli stakeholder esecutivi.

Riguardo al lavoro
Il team di Ads Metrics è il core data science team dietro Google Search Ads. Sviluppiamo meccanismi, progetti di esperimenti, metriche di valutazione, metodi statistici e librerie di analisi per aiutare a costruire la prossima generazione dei nostri prodotti pubblicitari di ricerca.

In qualità di Data Scientist nel team Ads Metrics, collaborerai a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri del software, i product manager, i ricercatori e gli analisti per spingere i confini della progettazione di esperimenti, l'inferenza causale e l'analisi delle serie temporali per i lanci business-critical.
Google Ads è all'avanguardia nell'innovazione dell'AI, applicando modelli di machine learning all'avanguardia e Generative AI come Gemini per alimentare un business globale di miliardi di dollari.

Il nostro lavoro colpisce direttamente miliardi di utenti proteggendo gli utenti da danni, migliorando la qualità degli annunci e ottimizzando le campagne per il ritorno degli inserzionisti sull'investimento. Adottiamo una cultura di profonda collaborazione, collaborando a stretto contatto con team come Google Research e DeepMind per risolvere complesse sfide. Unisciti a noi per lavorare su AI all'avanguardia, affrontare i problemi a una scala senza precedenti, e costruire la prossima generazione di tecnologia pubblicitaria.
responsabilità

• Guidare e gestire un sottoteam ad alto rendimento di scienziati di dati nell'area di Search Ads Targeting.

• Collabora con i nostri partner di ingegneria e prodotti per identificare le domande chiave da rispondere. Traduci e affina le domande aziendali in esperimenti appropriati, analisi, metriche di valutazione o modelli matematici.

• Architetto processi di analisi end-to-end, traducendo questioni ambigue in ambiti rigorosi e modelli statistici.

• Progettare e valutare esperimenti complessi o modelli (ad esempio, inferenza causale, modelli gerarchici) per risolvere problemi con limitato precedente nel recupero e nella classifica.

• Traduci la telemetria di sistema su larga scala in prove statisticamente solide, garantendo i più elevati standard di integrità dei dati per l'analisi di livello di ricerca che sblocca lanci da miliardi di dollari.
descriptionByLocale.en:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process

Minimum qualifications:

• Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, Economics, Operations Research, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

• 8 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 6 years of experience with a PhD degree.

• Experience building, managing, and leading teams of data scientists or quantitative researchers.

• Experience applying experiment design, regression analysis, and core statistics to perform data analysis that drives business analysis and decision-making.

Preferred qualifications:

• 10 years of experience using analytics to solve product or business problems, coding (e.g., Python, R, SQL), querying databases or statistical analysis, or 8 years of experience with a PhD degree.

• Experience in modern statistical theory, including experiment design, regression models, causal inference, sampling methods, time-series analysis, and hierarchical modeling.

• Strong data intuition and business acumen, with the experience in data analysis to solve business problems in complex, fast-moving, and ambiguous business environments.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to distill complex investigative findings for executive stakeholders.

About the job
The Ads Metrics team is the core data science team behind Google Search Ads. We develop mechanisms, experiment designs, evaluation metrics, statistical methods, and analysis libraries to help build the next generation of our Search advertising products.

As a Data Scientist in the Ads Metrics team, you will collaborate closely with software engineers, product managers, researchers, and analysts to push the boundaries of experiment design, causal inference, and time-series analysis for business-critical launches.
Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.

Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.
Responsibilities

• Lead and manage a high-performing subteam of data scientists in the area of Search Ads Targeting.

• Collaborate with our engineering and product partners to identify key questions to answer. Translate and refine business questions into appropriate experiments, analyses, evaluation metrics, or mathematical models.

• Architect end-to-end analysis pipelines, translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous frameworks and statistical models.

• Design and evaluate complex experiments or models (e.g., causal inference, hierarchical models) to solve problems with limited precedent in retrieval and ranking.

• Translate massive-scale system telemetry into statistically sound evidence, ensuring the highest standards of data integrity for research-grade analysis that unblocks billion-dollar launches.

Das Ads Metrics Team ist das zentrale Data Science Team hinter Google Search Ads. Wir entwickeln Mechanismen, Experimentdesigns, Auswertungsmetriken, statistische Methoden und Analysebibliotheken, um die nächste Generation unserer Search-Werbeprodukte zu entwickeln.

Arbeiten Sie mit uns an modernster KI, nehmen Sie Probleme in beispiellosem Umfang an und bauen Sie die nächste Generation von Werbetechnologie auf.

• Führen und verwalten Sie ein leistungsstarkes Unterteam von Data Scientists im Bereich Search Ads Targeting.

• Arbeiten Sie mit unseren Engineering- und Produktpartnern zusammen, um die wichtigsten zu beantwortenden Fragen zu identifizieren. Übersetzen und verfeinern Sie Geschäftsfragen in geeignete Experimente, Analysen, Bewertungsmetriken oder mathematische Modelle.

• Erstellen Sie End-to-End-Analyse-Pipelines, die mehrdeutige Geschäftsfragen in strenge Frameworks und statistische Modelle übersetzen.

• Entwerfen und bewerten Sie komplexe Experimente oder Modelle (z. B. kausale Inferenz, hierarchische Modelle), um Probleme mit begrenztem Präzedenzfall beim Abrufen und Ranking zu lösen.

• Übersetzen Sie massive Systemtelemetrie in statistisch fundierte Beweise und gewährleisten Sie die höchsten Standards der Datenintegrität für Analysen in Forschungsqualität, die Milliarden-Dollar-Starts freisetzen.

• Traduire la télémétrie massive des systèmes en données statistiquement solides, assurant les normes les plus élevées d'intégrité des données pour l'analyse de qualité de la recherche qui bloque les lancements de milliards de dollars.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.

• 4 years of experience leading projects, and providing technical leadership.

• 3 years of experience in designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting distributed systems.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.

• Experience with large-scale distributed systems.

• Experience in Generative AI Agent and Machine Learning.

• Experience in Trust and Safety operations.

About the job
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.
 Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

PSS SRE provides the indispensable security and compliance bedrock for Google's infrastructure. In the AI era, the PSS UTL's leadership is critical to navigating Google's evolving technological frontier—pioneering production safety baselines for rapid agentic scaling, containing blast-radii for non-deterministic AI pipelines, and scaling localized authorization to unblock Google's next wave of AI innovation and business growth. The PSS UTL will also ensure that PSS SRE is an agentic native SRE team.
Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible.
 Responsibilities

• Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services from inception and design, through to deployment, operation and refinement.

• Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, developing software platforms and frameworks, capacity planning and launch reviews.

• Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.

• Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.

• Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nella maggior parte dei casi, questa posizione richiede colloqui in presenza come parte del processo di assunzione.

Requisiti minimi:

• Laurea triennale in Informatica, in un campo correlato, o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione.

• 4 anni di esperienza nella guida di progetti e nella leadership tecnica.

• 3 anni di esperienza nella progettazione, analisi e risoluzione di problemi di sistemi distribuiti.

Qualifiche preferite:

• Master in Informatica o Ingegneria.

• Esperienza con sistemi distribuiti su larga scala.

• Esperienza in Generative AI Agent e Machine Learning.

• Esperienza in operazioni di Trust and Safety.

Informazioni sul lavoro
L'Ingegneria dell'Affidabilità del Sito (SRE) combina software e ingegneria dei sistemi per costruire e gestire sistemi su larga scala, distribuiti in modo massiccio e tolleranti ai guasti. SRE garantisce che i servizi di Google Cloud—sia quelli internamente critici che quelli visibili esternamente—abbiano affidabilità, tempo di attività adeguato alle esigenze dei clienti e un rapido ritmo di miglioramento. Inoltre, gli SRE terranno un controllo costante sulla capacità e le prestazioni dei nostri sistemi.
Gran parte del nostro sviluppo software si concentra sull'ottimizzazione dei sistemi esistenti, la costruzione di infrastrutture e l'eliminazione del lavoro tramite automazione. Nel team SRE, avrai l'opportunità di gestire le complesse sfide di scala che sono uniche di Google Cloud, utilizzando la tua esperienza in programmazione, algoritmi, analisi della complessità e progettazione di sistemi su larga scala. La cultura di SRE basata sulla curiosità intellettuale, la risoluzione dei problemi e l'apertura è fondamentale per il suo successo. La nostra organizzazione riunisce persone con una grande varietà di background, esperienze e prospettive. Le incoraggiamo a collaborare, pensare in grande e correre rischi in un ambiente senza colpe. Promuoviamo l'autodirezione per lavorare su progetti significativi, cercando anche di creare un ambiente che offra il supporto e la mentorship necessari per imparare e crescere.

PSS SRE fornisce la base indispensabile di sicurezza e conformità per l'infrastruttura di Google. Nell'era dell'IA, la leadership di PSS UTL è fondamentale per orientarsi nella frontiera tecnologica in evoluzione di Google—pionierizzando le linee di sicurezza in produzione per una rapida scala agentica, contenendo raggi di esplosione per pipeline di IA non deterministiche e scalando l'autorizzazione localizzata per sbloccare la prossima ondata di innovazione e crescita aziendale di Google nell'IA. Il PSS UTL garantirà inoltre che PSS SRE sia un team di SRE nativo agente.
Dietro tutto ciò che i nostri utenti vedono online c'è l'architettura costruita dal team Infrastruttura Tecnica per mantenerla in funzione. Dallo sviluppo e la manutenzione dei nostri data center alla costruzione della prossima generazione di piattaforme Google, rendiamo possibile il portafoglio prodotti di Google. Siamo orgogliosi di essere gli ingegneri dei nostri ingegneri e amiamo annullare le garanzie smontando le cose per poterle ricostruire. Manteniamo le nostre reti operative, assicurandoci che i nostri utenti abbiano la migliore e più veloce esperienza possibile.
Responsabilità

• Impegnarsi e migliorare l'intero ciclo di vita dei servizi, dall'inizio e progettazione, fino all'implementazione, all'operatività e al perfezionamento.

• Servizi di supporto prima che vengano attivati attraverso attività come consulenza per la progettazione di sistemi, sviluppo di piattaforme e framework software, pianificazione delle capacità e revisioni di lancio.

• Mantenere i servizi una volta attivi misurando e monitorando la disponibilità, la latenza e la salute complessiva del sistema.

• Scalare i sistemi in modo sostenibile attraverso meccanismi come l'automazione, ed evolverli spingendo per cambiamenti che migliorino affidabilità e velocità.

• Pratica una risposta sostenibile agli incidenti e post-mortem senza colpe.

In den meisten Fällen erfordert diese Position persönliche Vorstellungsgespräche im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses.

Mindestqualifikationen:

• Bachelorabschluss in Informatik, einem verwandten Fachgebiet oder gleichwertige praktische Erfahrung.

• 8 Jahre Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen.

• 4 Jahre Erfahrung in der Projektleitung und technischer Führung.

• 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Entwerfen, Analysieren und Troubleshooting verteilter Systeme.

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Masterabschluss in Informatik oder Ingenieurwesen.

• Erfahrung mit groß angelegten verteilten Systemen.

• Erfahrung im Bereich generativer KI-Agenten und maschinellem Lernen.

• Erfahrung im Bereich Trust and Safety-Betrieb.

Über die Arbeit
Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) kombiniert Software- und Systemtechnik, um groß angelegte, massiv verteilte, fehlertolerante Systeme zu bauen und zu betreiben. SRE stellt sicher, dass die Dienste von Google Cloud – sowohl unsere intern kritischen als auch unsere extern sichtbaren Systeme – Zuverlässigkeit, Verfügbarkeit und eine schnelle Verbesserungsrate besitzen. Darüber hinaus werden SREs die Kapazität und Leistung unserer Systeme stets genau beobachten.
Ein Großteil unserer Softwareentwicklung konzentriert sich auf die Optimierung bestehender Systeme, den Aufbau von Infrastruktur und die Beseitigung von Arbeit durch Automatisierung. Im SRE-Team haben Sie die Möglichkeit, die komplexen Skalierungsherausforderungen, die für Google Cloud einzigartig sind, zu bewältigen und dabei Ihre Expertise in Programmierung, Algorithmen, Komplexitätsanalyse und groß angelegtem Systemdesign zu nutzen. Die Kultur von SRE aus intellektueller Neugier, Problemlösung und Offenheit ist der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Unsere Organisation bringt Menschen mit unterschiedlichsten Hintergründen, Erfahrungen und Perspektiven zusammen. Wir ermutigen sie, zusammenzuarbeiten, groß zu denken und Risiken in einer schuldfreien Umgebung einzugehen. Wir fördern Selbststeuerung bei der Arbeit an sinnvollen Projekten und bemühen uns zugleich, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, das die Unterstützung und Mentoring bietet, die zum Lernen und Wachsen notwendig sind.

PSS SRE bildet das unverzichtbare Sicherheits- und Compliance-Fundament für Googles Infrastruktur. Im KI-Zeitalter ist die Führungsrolle des PSS UTL entscheidend, um sich in Googles sich entwickelnder technologischer Grenze zu navigieren – es führt Marktsicherheitsgrundlagen für schnelle agentische Skalierung ein, begrenzt Explosionsradien für nichtdeterministische KI-Pipelines und skaliert lokale Autorisierungen, um Googles nächste Welle von KI-Innovation und Geschäftswachstum zu entblocken. Das PSS UTL stellt außerdem sicher, dass PSS SRE ein agentisches natives SRE-Team ist.
Hinter allem, was unsere Nutzer online sehen, steht die vom Technical Infrastructure-Team entwickelte Architektur, um sie am Laufen zu halten. Von der Entwicklung und Wartung unserer Rechenzentren bis hin zur Entwicklung der nächsten Generation von Google-Plattformen machen wir das Produktportfolio von Google möglich. Wir sind stolz darauf, die Ingenieure unserer Ingenieure zu sein, und lieben es, Garantien zu erlöschen, indem wir Dinge auseinandernehmen, um sie wieder aufzubauen. Wir halten unsere Netzwerke am Laufen und sorgen dafür, dass unsere Nutzer das bestmögliche und schnellste Erlebnis haben.
Verantwortlichkeiten

• Beteiligen Sie sich an und verbessern Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus der Dienstleistungen von der Entstehung und Gestaltung über die Einführung bis hin zur Bereitstellung, Betrieb und Verfeinerung.

• Unterstützungsdienste, bevor sie live gehen, durch Aktivitäten wie Systemdesignberatung, Entwicklung von Softwareplattformen und Frameworks, Kapazitätsplanung und Launch-Reviews.

• Pflegen Sie die Dienste, sobald sie live sind, indem Sie Verfügbarkeit, Latenz und den allgemeinen Systemzustand messen und überwachen.

• Skalieren Sie Systeme nachhaltig durch Mechanismen wie Automatisierung und entwickeln Sie Systeme, indem Sie Veränderungen vorantreiben, die Zuverlässigkeit und Geschwindigkeit verbessern.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Dans la plupart des cas, ce poste nécessite des entretiens en personne dans le cadre du processus de recrutement.

Qualifications minimales :

• Licence en informatique, domaine connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente.

• 8 ans d'expérience en développement logiciel dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation.

• 4 ans d'expérience à la tête de projets et à la fourniture de leadership technique.

• 3 ans d'expérience dans la conception, l'analyse et le dépannage de systèmes distribués.

Qualifications préférées :

• Un master en informatique ou en génie informatique.

• Expérience avec des systèmes distribués à grande échelle.

• Expérience en IA générative et apprentissage automatique.

• Expérience en opérations de confiance et de sécurité.

À propos du travail
L'ingénierie de la fiabilité du site (SRE) combine l'ingénierie logicielle et des systèmes pour construire et faire fonctionner des systèmes à grande échelle, massivement distribués et tolérants aux pannes. Le SRE garantit que les services de Google Cloud — tant pour les systèmes critiques en interne que pour les externes — bénéficient de fiabilité, d'un temps de disponibilité adapté aux besoins des clients et d'un rythme d'amélioration rapide. De plus, les SRE garderont un œil toujours vigilant sur la capacité et la performance de nos systèmes.
Une grande partie de notre développement logiciel se concentre sur l'optimisation des systèmes existants, la construction d'infrastructures et l'élimination du travail via l'automatisation. Dans l'équipe SRE, vous aurez l'opportunité de gérer les défis complexes d'échelle, propres à Google Cloud, tout en utilisant votre expertise en codage, algorithmes, analyse de complexité et conception de systèmes à grande échelle. La culture de SRE axée sur la curiosité intellectuelle, la résolution de problèmes et l'ouverture est la clé de son succès. Notre organisation rassemble des personnes aux parcours très variés, expériences et perspectives. Nous les encourageons à collaborer, à penser grand et à prendre des risques dans un environnement sans reproches. Nous encourageons l'auto-direction pour travailler sur des projets significatifs, tout en nous efforçant également de créer un environnement qui offre le soutien et le mentorat nécessaires pour apprendre et évoluer.

PSS SRE fournit la base indispensable de sécurité et de conformité pour l'infrastructure de Google. À l'ère de l'IA, le leadership du PSS UTL est essentiel pour naviguer dans la frontière technologique évolutive de Google — pionnier des bases de sécurité en production pour une mise à l'échelle agentique rapide, contenir des rayons d'explosion pour les pipelines d'IA non déterministes, et étendre l'autorisation localisée pour débloquer la prochaine vague d'innovation en IA et de croissance commerciale de Google. Le PSS UTL garantira également que PSS SRE soit une équipe SRE native agentique.
Derrière tout ce que nos utilisateurs voient en ligne se cache l'architecture construite par l'équipe Infrastructure Technique pour la maintenir en fonctionnement. Du développement et la maintenance de nos centres de données à la création de la prochaine génération de plateformes Google, nous rendons possible le portefeuille de produits de Google. Nous sommes fiers d'être les ingénieurs de nos ingénieurs et adorons annuler les garanties en démontant les choses pour pouvoir les reconstruire. Nous maintenons nos réseaux opérationnels, garantissant à nos utilisateurs la meilleure et la plus rapide expérience possible.
Responsabilités

• Engagez-vous et améliorez l'ensemble du cycle de vie des services, depuis la conception et la conception, jusqu'au déploiement, l'exploitation et l'affinement.

• Des services de soutien avant leur mise en ligne à travers des activités telles que le conseil en conception de systèmes, le développement de plateformes et de cadres logiciels, la planification des capacités et les revues de lancement.

• Maintenez les services une fois opérationnels en mesurant et surveillant la disponibilité, la latence et l'état général du système.

• Faire évoluer les systèmes de manière durable grâce à des mécanismes comme l'automatisation, et faire évoluer les systèmes en poussant pour des changements qui améliorent la fiabilité et la rapidité.

• Adoptez une réponse durable aux incidents et des autopsies sans faute.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or a related field.

• 2 years of experience designing, analyzing, and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.

About the job
 Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) combines software and systems engineering to build and run large-scale, massively distributed, fault-tolerant systems. SRE ensures that Google Cloud's services—both our internally critical and our externally-visible systems—have reliability, uptime appropriate to customer's needs and a fast rate of improvement. Additionally SRE’s will keep an ever-watchful eye on our systems capacity and performance.
 Much of our software development focuses on optimizing existing systems, building infrastructure and eliminating work through automation. On the SRE team, you’ll have the opportunity to manage the complex challenges of scale which are unique to Google Cloud, while using your expertise in coding, algorithms, complexity analysis and large-scale system design. SRE's culture of intellectual curiosity, problem solving and openness is key to its success. Our organization brings together people with a wide variety of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We encourage them to collaborate, think big and take risks in a blame-free environment. We promote self-direction to work on meaningful projects, while we also strive to create an environment that provides the support and mentorship needed to learn and grow.

Responsibilities

• Write product or system development code.

• Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

• Contribute to existing documentation or educational content and adapt content based on product/program updates and user feedback.

• Triage product or system issues and debug/track/resolve by analyzing the sources of issues and the impact on hardware, network, or service operations and quality.

• Participate in, or lead design reviews with peers and stakeholders to decide amongst available technologies.

Inoltre SRE manterrà un occhio sempre attento alla capacità e alle prestazioni dei nostri sistemi.

La cultura della curiosità intellettuale di SRE, la risoluzione dei problemi e l'apertura è fondamentale per il suo successo. jobs.description:
Please complete your application before 13th November 2026. We encourage you to apply as early as possible as we review applications on a rolling basis.
This internship is intended for students enrolled in their penultimate/final year of education in an accredited Master's full-time degree program located in the EMEA region. Participation in the internship program requires that you are located in Switzerland for the duration of the internship program. Interns will be required to be available to work full-time for a minimum of 13 weeks over the Summer 2027 (starting in May, June or July) for the duration of the program. Individuals applying for this position will not be eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Timing on when you can hear back will vary and can take upwards of 90+ days. If you haven’t heard from us in three months about an application, we likely proceeded with other candidates for that particular role. However, our recruiters might reach out if we find a different potential match for your skills, interests, and experience.
To start the application process, you will need an updated CV or resume and a current unofficial or official transcript in English. Click on the “Apply” button on this page and provide the required materials in the appropriate sections (PDFs preferred):
In the “Resume Section:” attach an updated CV or resume
In the “Education Section:” attach a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.
Under “Degree Status,” select “Now attending” to upload a transcript.
Please include your expected graduation date (month and year) and availability for the internship on your resume. The specific team and project(s) will be determined based on your educational background, interest and skills.

Minimum qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Sciences, etc.), or a related technical field in the EMEA region.

• Relevant practical or internship experience working with statistical packages (e.g., R, SAS, Stata, MATLAB, etc.).

• Relevant practical or internship experience articulating product questions, pulling data from datasets (SQL or Python), and using statistics to arrive at an answer.

Preferred qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in your penultimate/final year of education.

• Ability to translate analysis results into business recommendations.

• Ability to complete a minimum 13 week full-time internship in the internship location starting in either May, June or July 2027.

• Interest and ability to work with data, metrics, analysis and trends and applied knowledge of measurement, statistics and program evaluation.

• Excellent problem-solving, written/verbal communication, and business judgment skills.

About the job
 In the Data Scientist product role, you will provide quantitative analysis, market expertise and a strategic perspective to our partners throughout the organisation. As a member of the team, you'll serve as an analytics expert for your partners, using numbers to help them make better decisions. You will weave stories with meaningful insight from data. You'll make key recommendations for Googlers in Engineering and Product Management.
 Google is and always will be an engineering company. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to address some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

• Conduct data analysis to make business or product recommendations (i.e., cost-benefit, invest-divest, forecasting, impact analysis).

• Deliver effective presentations of findings and recommendations to multiple levels of stakeholders, creating visual displays of quantitative information.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their business needs, formulate and complete analysis that includes data gathering, analysis, ongoing scaled deliverables and presentations.

• Help Google to focus on key decisions to improve products and services.

Interns will be required to be available to work full-time for a minimum of 13 weeks over the Summer 2027 (starting in May, June or July) for the duration of the program. Individuals applying for this position will not be eligible for immigration sponsorship.

Timing on when you can hear back will vary and can take upwards of 90+ days. If you haven’t heard from us in three months about an application, we likely proceeded with other candidates for that particular role. However, our recruiters might reach out if we find a different potential match for your skills, interests, and experience.
To start the application process, you will need an updated CV or resume and a current unofficial or official transcript in English. Click on the “Apply” button on this page and provide the required materials in the appropriate sections (PDFs preferred):
In the “Resume Section:” attach an updated CV or resume
In the “Education Section:” attach a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.
Under “Degree Status,” select “Now attending” to upload a transcript.
Please include your expected graduation date (month and year) and availability for the internship on your resume. The specific team and project(s) will be determined based on your educational background, interest and skills.

Minimum qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a Master's degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Sciences, etc.), or a related technical field in the EMEA region.

• Relevant practical or internship experience working with statistical packages (e.g., R, SAS, Stata, MATLAB, etc.).

• Relevant practical or internship experience articulating product questions, pulling data from datasets (SQL or Python), and using statistics to arrive at an answer.

Preferred qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in your penultimate/final year of education.

• Ability to translate analysis results into business recommendations.

• Ability to complete a minimum 13 week full-time internship in the internship location starting in either May, June or July 2027.

• Interest and ability to work with data, metrics, analysis and trends and applied knowledge of measurement, statistics and program evaluation.

• Excellent problem-solving, written/verbal communication, and business judgment skills.

About the job
In the Data Scientist product role, you will provide quantitative analysis, market expertise and a strategic perspective to our partners throughout the organisation. As a member of the team, you'll serve as an analytics expert for your partners, using numbers to help them make better decisions. You will weave stories with meaningful insight from data. You'll make key recommendations for Googlers in Engineering and Product Management.
Google is and always will be an engineering company. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to address some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on millions, if not billions, of users. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on massive scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, Social to Local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

• Conduct data analysis to make business or product recommendations (i.e., cost-benefit, invest-divest, forecasting, impact analysis).

• Deliver effective presentations of findings and recommendations to multiple levels of stakeholders, creating visual displays of quantitative information.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand their business needs, formulate and complete analysis that includes data gathering, analysis, ongoing scaled deliverables and presentations.

• Help Google to focus on key decisions to improve products and services.

jobs.description:
Please complete your application before 14th December 2026. We encourage you to apply as early as possible as we review applications on a rolling basis.
This internship is intended for students enrolled in their penultimate/final year of education in an accredited full-time PhD degree program located in the EMEA region. Participation in the internship program requires that you are located in Switzerland or Germany for the duration of the internship program. Interns will be required to be available to work full-time for a minimum of 13 weeks over the Summer 2027 (starting in either May, June or July) for the duration of the program. Individuals applying for this position will not be eligible for immigration sponsorship.

To start the application process, you will need an updated CV or resume and a current unofficial or official transcript in English. Click on the “Apply” button on this page and provide the required materials in the appropriate sections (PDFs preferred):

1. In the “Resume Section:” attach an updated CV or resume.
2. In the “Education Section:” attach a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English.
Under “Degree Status,” select “Now attending” to upload a transcript.

Please include your expected graduation date (month and year), and availability for the internship on your resume. The specific team and project(s) will be determined based on your educational background, interest and skills.

We offer a range of internships in Software Engineering across EMEA. Durations and start dates will vary according to project and location. Our recruitment team will determine where you fit best based on your resume.

Minimum qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a PhD degree in Computer Science or a related technical field in the EMEA region, and in your penultimate/final year of education.

• Experience working with data structures or algorithms during coursework/projects, research, internships, or practical experience in school or work (e.g., open-source coding).

• Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C++, Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.).

Preferred qualifications:

• Relevant practical or internship experience (e.g., research assistant, teaching assistant, personal projects, etc) with programming in either: C++, Java, Python, or Go.

• Research experience in algorithms, architecture, artificial intelligence, compilers, database, data mining, distributed systems, machine learning, networking, or systems.

• Relevant practical or internship experience with one or more of the following: web application development, Unix/Linux, mobile application development, distributed and parallel systems, machine learning, information retrieval, NLP, networking, developing large software systems, or security software development.

• Ability to complete a 13-17 week full-time internship in Switzerland or Germany starting in either May, June or July 2027.

About the job
 Software Engineering Intern:
 As a key member of a versatile team, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs. We need our engineers to be versatile, and enthusiastic in addressing problems as we continue to push technology forward. You will design, test, deploy and maintain software solutions as you grow and evolve during your internship.

Site Reliability Intern:
Our engineers create, fix, extend and scale the code to keep it working and to harden it against all the bad actors of the internet. We drive reliability and performance on a massive scale. You will work on software development projects to keep important business generating-critical systems up and running, from code-level troubleshooting of traffic anomalies to maintenance of our services; from monitoring and alerts to building automation infrastructure.
 Google is an engineering company at heart. We hire people with a broad set of technical skills who are ready to take on some of technology's greatest challenges and make an impact on users around the world. At Google, engineers not only revolutionize search, they routinely work on scalability and storage solutions, large-scale applications and entirely new platforms for developers around the world. From Google Ads to Chrome, Android to YouTube, social to local, Google engineers are changing the world one technological achievement after another.

Responsibilities

• Research, conceive and develop software applications to extend and improve on Google's product offering.

• Contribute to a wide variety of projects using natural language processing, artificial intelligence, data compression, machine learning, and search technologies.

• Collaborate on scalability issues involing access to data and information.

• Utilise exposure to large-scale production software troubleshooting.

• Help maintain mission critical services.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Ti invitiamo a completare la tua domanda entro il 23 ottobre 2026. Ti invitiamo a candidarti il prima possibile mentre esaminiamo le domande su base continuativa.
Questo tirocinio è destinato agli studenti iscritti al penultimo/ultimo anno di formazione in un programma di dottorato a tempo pieno accreditato situato nella regione EMEA. La partecipazione al programma di tirocinio richiede che si sia in Svizzera o Germania per tutta la durata del programma. Gli stagisti dovranno essere disponibili per lavorare a tempo pieno per un minimo di 13 settimane durante l'estate 2027 (a partire da maggio, giugno o luglio) per tutta la durata del programma. Le persone che fanno domanda per questa posizione non saranno idonee per la sponsorizzazione dell'immigrazione.

Per iniziare il processo di candidatura, avrai bisogno di un CV o di un curriculum aggiornato e di un certificato di studi non ufficiale o ufficiale in inglese. Clicca sul pulsante "Applica" in questa pagina e fornisci i materiali necessari nelle sezioni appropriate (preferibilmente PDF):

1. Nella sezione "Curriculum:" allega un CV o un curriculum aggiornato.
2. Nella sezione "Educazione:" allega un certificato non ufficiale o ufficiale attuale o recente in inglese.
Sotto "Stato del titolo", seleziona "Attualmente in corso" per caricare il certificato.

Includi la data prevista di laurea (mese e anno) e la disponibilità per lo stage nel curriculum. Il team specifico e i progetti saranno determinati in base al tuo percorso educativo, interessi e competenze.

Offriamo una gamma di stage in Ingegneria del Software in tutta la regione EMEA. Le durate e le date di inizio variano in base al progetto e alla località. Il nostro team di selezione determinerà dove ti trovi meglio in base al tuo curriculum.

Requisiti minimi:

• Attualmente iscritto a un dottorato in Informatica o in un campo tecnico correlato nella regione EMEA, e nel penultimo o ultimo anno di formazione.

• Esperienza nel lavorare con strutture dati o algoritmi durante corsi/progetti, ricerche, tirocini o esperienza pratica a scuola o sul lavoro (ad esempio, programmazione open-source).

• Esperienza con uno o più linguaggi di programmazione generici (ad esempio, Java, C/C++, Python, JavaScript, Go, ecc.).

Qualifiche preferite:

• Esperienza pratica o di tirocinio rilevante (ad esempio, assistente di ricerca, assistente didattico, progetti personali, ecc.) con programmazione in C++, Java, Python o Go.

• Esperienza di ricerca in algoritmi, architettura, intelligenza artificiale, compilatori, database, data mining, sistemi distribuiti, machine learning, networking o sistemi.

• Esperienza pratica o di tirocinio pertinente in uno o più dei seguenti argomenti: sviluppo di applicazioni web, Unix/Linux, sviluppo di applicazioni mobili, sistemi distribuiti e paralleli, machine learning, recupero delle informazioni, NLP, reti, sviluppo di grandi sistemi software o sviluppo di software di sicurezza.

• Possibilità di completare uno stage a tempo pieno di 13-17 settimane in Svizzera o Germania a partire da maggio, giugno o luglio 2027.

Informazioni sul lavoro
Stagista in Ingegneria del Software:
Come membro chiave di un team versatile, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili ed entusiasti nell'affrontare i problemi mentre continuiamo a far progredire la tecnologia. Progetterai, testerai, distribuirai e manterrai soluzioni software mentre cresci ed evolvi durante il tuo tirocinio.

Tirocinante nell'affidabilità del sito:
I nostri ingegneri creano, correggono, estendono e scalano il codice per mantenerlo funzionante e per rafforzarlo contro tutti i malintenzionati di internet. Promuoviamo affidabilità e prestazioni su scala massiccia. Lavorerai su progetti di sviluppo software per mantenere operativi sistemi importanti per la generazione di attività critica, dalla risoluzione a livello di codice delle anomalie di traffico alla manutenzione dei nostri servizi; dal monitoraggio e agli avvisi all'infrastruttura di automazione degli edifici.
Google è un'azienda di ingegneria nel profondo. Assumiamo persone con un ampio set di competenze tecniche, pronte ad affrontare alcune delle sfide più grandi della tecnologia e a lasciare un impatto sugli utenti di tutto il mondo. In Google, gli ingegneri non solo rivoluzionano la ricerca, ma lavorano regolarmente su soluzioni di scalabilità e storage, applicazioni su larga scala e piattaforme completamente nuove per sviluppatori in tutto il mondo. Da Google Ads a Chrome, da Android a YouTube, dai social al locale, gli ingegneri di Google stanno cambiando il mondo un risultato tecnologico dopo l'altro.

Responsabilità

• Ricerca, concepire e sviluppare applicazioni software per estendere e migliorare l'offerta di prodotti di Google.

• Contribuire a una vasta gamma di progetti utilizzando tecnologie di elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, intelligenza artificiale, compressione dei dati, apprendimento automatico e ricerca.

• Collaborare su questioni di scalabilità che coinvolgono l'accesso a dati e informazioni.

• Sfrutta l'esposizione a soluzioni software di produzione su larga scala.

• Aiuta a mantenere i servizi mission-critical.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bitte füllen Sie Ihren Antrag bis zum 23. Oktober 2026 ab. Wir empfehlen Ihnen, sich so früh wie möglich zu bewerben, da wir die Bewerbungen fortlaufend prüfen.
Dieses Praktikum richtet sich an Studierende, die ihr vorletztes/letztes Studienjahr in einem akkreditierten Vollzeit-PhD-Programm in der EMEA-Region eingeschrieben sind. Die Teilnahme am Praktikumsprogramm erfordert, dass Sie sich während der gesamten Praktikumsdauer in der Schweiz oder in Deutschland befinden. Praktikanten müssen für die Dauer des Programms mindestens 13 Wochen Vollzeit im Sommer 2027 (beginnend im Mai, Juni oder Juli) zur Verfügung stehen. Personen, die sich für diese Position bewerben, sind nicht für Einwanderungssponsoring berechtigt.

Um den Bewerbungsprozess zu starten, benötigen Sie einen aktualisierten Lebenslauf sowie ein aktuelles, inoffizielles oder offizielles Transkript auf Englisch. Klicken Sie auf die Schaltfläche "Bewerben" auf dieser Seite und stellen Sie die erforderlichen Unterlagen in den entsprechenden Abschnitten (PDFs bevorzugt) bereit:

1. Im Abschnitt "Lebenslauf": Fügen Sie einen aktualisierten Lebenslauf oder Lebenslauf bei.
2. Im Abschnitt "Bildung": Fügen Sie ein aktuelles, aktuelles, inoffizielles oder offizielles Transkript auf Englisch bei.
Unter "Abschlussstatus" wählen Sie "Jetzt studierend" aus, um ein Zeugnis hochzuladen.

Bitte geben Sie Ihr erwartetes Abschlussdatum (Monat und Jahr) sowie die Verfügbarkeit des Praktikums in Ihrem Lebenslauf an. Das spezifische Team und die Projekt(e) werden basierend auf Ihrem Bildungshintergrund, Ihren Interessen und Ihren Fähigkeiten bestimmt.

Wir bieten eine Vielzahl von Praktika im Bereich Software Engineering in ganz EMEA an. Dauern und Starttermine variieren je nach Projekt und Standort. Unser Rekrutierungsteam bestimmt anhand Ihres Lebenslaufs, wo Sie am besten passen.

Mindestqualifikationen:

• Ich bin derzeit in einem PhD-Studium in Informatik oder einem verwandten technischen Bereich in der EMEA-Region eingeschrieben und befindet sich im vorletzten/letzten Ausbildungsjahr.

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Datenstrukturen oder Algorithmen während Kursen/Projekten, Forschung, Praktika oder praktischer Erfahrung in Schule oder Arbeit (z. B. Open-Source-Programmierung).

• Erfahrung mit einer oder mehreren allgemeinen Programmiersprachen (z. B. Java, C/C++, Python, JavaScript, Go usw.).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Relevante praktische oder Praktikumserfahrung (z. B. Forschungsassistent, Lehrassistent, persönliche Projekte usw.) mit Programmierung in C++, Java, Python oder Go.

• Forschungserfahrung in den Bereichen Algorithmen, Architektur, Künstliche Intelligenz, Compiler, Datenbanken, Data Mining, verteilte Systeme, maschinelles Lernen, Netzwerke oder Systeme.

• Relevante praktische oder Praktikumserfahrung mit einem oder mehreren der folgenden Bereiche: Webanwendungsentwicklung, Unix/Linux, Entwicklung mobiler Anwendungen, verteilte und parallele Systeme, maschinelles Lernen, Informationsabruf, NLP, Netzwerke, Entwicklung großer Softwaresysteme oder Entwicklung von Sicherheitssoftware.

• Möglichkeit, ab Mai, Juni oder Juli 2027 ein 13- bis 17-wöchiges Vollzeitpraktikum in der Schweiz oder Deutschland abzusolvieren.

Über die Arbeit
Softwareingenieur-Praktikant:
Als Schlüsselmitglied eines vielseitigen Teams wirst du an einem spezifischen Projekt arbeiten, das für Googles Bedürfnisse entscheidend ist. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig und engagiert bei der Problemlösung sind, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben. Du wirst Softwarelösungen entwerfen, testen, bereitstellen und warten, während du während deines Praktikums wächst und weiterentwickelst.

Praktikant für die Zuverlässigkeit vor Ort:
Unsere Ingenieure erstellen, reparieren, erweitern und skalieren den Code, um ihn am Laufen zu halten und ihn gegen alle Schadensakteure des Internets zu verstärken. Wir steigern Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung in großem Maßstab. Sie arbeiten an Softwareentwicklungsprojekten, um wichtige, geschäftsgenerierende kritische Systeme am Laufen zu halten – von Code-Level-Fehlerbehebung von Verkehrsanomalien bis zur Wartung unserer Dienste; von Überwachung und Warnungen bis hin zur Gebäude-Automatisierungsinfrastruktur.
Google ist im Herzen ein Ingenieurunternehmen. Wir stellen Menschen mit einem breiten Spektrum technischer Fähigkeiten ein, die bereit sind, einige der größten Herausforderungen der Technologie anzugehen und weltweit einen Einfluss auf Nutzer zu haben. Bei Google revolutionieren Ingenieure nicht nur die Suche, sondern arbeiten routinemäßig an Skalierbarkeits- und Speicherlösungen, groß angelegten Anwendungen und völlig neuen Plattformen für Entwickler weltweit. Von Google Ads über Chrome, Android bis YouTube, Social Media bis lokal – Google-Ingenieure verändern die Welt mit technologischem Erfolg nach Technologie.

Verantwortlichkeiten

• Erforsche, entwickle und entwickle Softwareanwendungen, um das Produktangebot von Google zu erweitern und zu verbessern.

• Tragen Sie zu einer Vielzahl von Projekten bei, die natürliche Sprachverarbeitung, künstliche Intelligenz, Datenkompression, maschinelles Lernen und Suchtechnologien einsetzen.

• Arbeiten Sie an Skalierbarkeitsfragen rund um den Zugang zu Daten und Informationen zusammen.

• Nutzen Sie Erfahrung mit großflächiger Fehlerbehebung von Produktionssoftware.

• Helfen Sie dabei, missionskritische Dienste aufrechtzuerhalten.
