Ce stage est destiné aux étudiants inscrits en avant-dernière année d'études dans un programme de doctorat à temps plein accrédité situé dans la région EMEA. La participation au programme de stage nécessite que vous soyez situé en Suisse ou en Allemagne pendant toute la durée du stage. Les stagiaires devront être disponibles pour travailler à temps plein pendant un minimum de 13 semaines durant l'été 2027 (à partir de mai, juin ou juillet) pendant toute la durée du programme. Les personnes postulant à ce poste ne seront pas éligibles au parrainage d'immigration.

Pour commencer le processus de candidature, vous aurez besoin d'un CV ou d'un CV mis à jour ainsi qu'un relevé de notes non officiel ou non officiel en anglais. Cliquez sur le bouton « Postuler » sur cette page et fournissez les documents requis dans les sections appropriées (PDF préféré) :

1. Dans la section « CV » : joignez un CV ou un CV mis à jour.
2. Dans la section « Éducation » : joignez un relevé de notes non officiel ou récent en anglais.
Sous « Statut du diplôme », sélectionnez « Actuellement présent » pour télécharger un relevé de notes.

Veuillez inclure votre date de remise de diplôme prévue (mois et année) ainsi que la disponibilité du stage sur votre CV. L'équipe spécifique et les projets seront déterminés en fonction de votre parcours scolaire, de vos intérêts et de vos compétences.

Nous proposons une gamme de stages en ingénierie logicielle à travers l'EMEA. Les durées et dates de début varient selon le projet et le lieu. Notre équipe de recrutement déterminera où vous vous situez le mieux en fonction de votre CV.

Qualifications minimales :

• Je suis actuellement inscrit à un doctorat en informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe dans la région EMEA, et en avant-dernière année d'études.

• Expérience de travail avec des structures de données ou des algorithmes lors de cours/projets, de recherches, de stages ou d'expérience pratique à l'école ou au travail (par exemple, le codage open source).

• Expérience avec un ou plusieurs langages de programmation à usage général (par exemple, Java, C/C++, Python, JavaScript, Go, etc.).

Qualifications préférées :

• Expérience pratique ou de stage pertinente (par exemple, assistant de recherche, assistant d'enseignement, projets personnels, etc.) en programmation en C++, Java, Python ou Go.

• Expérience de recherche en algorithmes, architecture, intelligence artificielle, compilateurs, bases de données, exploration de données, systèmes distribués, apprentissage automatique, réseaux ou systèmes.

• Expérience pratique ou de stage pertinente dans l'un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants : développement d'applications web, Unix/Linux, développement d'applications mobiles, systèmes distribués et parallèles, apprentissage automatique, recherche d'information, NLP, réseautage, développement de grands systèmes logiciels ou développement de logiciels de sécurité.

• Possibilité d'effectuer un stage à temps plein de 13 à 17 semaines en Suisse ou en Allemagne à partir de mai, juin ou juillet 2027.

À propos du travail
Stagiaire en génie logiciel :
En tant que membre clé d'une équipe polyvalente, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour les besoins de Google. Nous avons besoin que nos ingénieurs soient polyvalents et enthousiastes pour résoudre les problèmes alors que nous continuons à faire avancer la technologie. Vous concevez, testerez, déployerez et maintiendrez des solutions logicielles tout en grandissant et évoluant durant votre stage.

Stagiaire en fiabilité du site :
Nos ingénieurs créent, corrigent, étendent et évoluent le code pour le maintenir en fonctionnement et le renforcer contre tous les acteurs malveillants d'Internet. Nous favorisons la fiabilité et la performance à grande échelle. Vous travaillerez sur des projets de développement logiciel pour maintenir en fonctionnement des systèmes importants pour la génération d'activités, du dépannage au niveau du code des anomalies de circulation à la maintenance de nos services ; de la surveillance et des alertes à l'automatisation des infrastructures de bâtiments.
Google est une entreprise d'ingénierie dans l'âme. Nous recrutons des personnes dotées d'un large éventail de compétences techniques, prêtes à relever certains des plus grands défis technologiques et à avoir un impact sur les utilisateurs du monde entier. Chez Google, les ingénieurs ne se contentent pas de révolutionner la recherche, ils travaillent régulièrement sur des solutions de scalabilité et de stockage, des applications à grande échelle et des plateformes entièrement nouvelles pour les développeurs du monde entier. De Google Ads à Chrome, d'Android à YouTube, des réseaux sociaux au local, les ingénieurs de Google changent le monde une réussite technologique après l'autre.

Responsabilités

• Recherchez, concevez et développez des applications logicielles pour étendre et améliorer l'offre de produits de Google.

• Contribuer à une grande variété de projets utilisant le traitement du langage naturel, l'intelligence artificielle, la compression de données, l'apprentissage automatique et les technologies de recherche.

• Collaborer sur les questions de scalabilité impliquant l'accès aux données et informations.

• Profitez de l'exposition au dépannage logiciel de production à grande échelle.

• Aider à maintenir les services critiques pour la mission.

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 5 years of experience with software development, including testing and launching software products.

• 3 years of experience optimizing ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning).

• 2 years of experience with GenAI techniques (e.g., Large Language Models (LLMs), Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree, PhD or Postdoc in Computer Science, Applied Math, Computational Sciences, or a related scientific discipline.

• 3 years of experience with deep learning frameworks (e.g., JAX, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and algorithmic background.

• 1 year of experience in a technical leadership role.

• Experience driving independent, research-adjacent software development and translating academic theories into scalable products.

• Record of technical or scientific contributions to complex, large-scale projects.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.

Co-Scientist is a multi-agent AI system built on Gemini designed to act as an autonomous virtual scientific colleague. It utilises a generate, debate, and evolve approach to accelerate scientific discovery enabling researchers to synthesize literature, evaluate hypotheses, and optimize experimental designs.

As a Staff Research Software Engineer (R-SWE), you will act as a principal technical bridge, translating scientific AI research into robust, scalable, and intuitive software systems. You will lead the design and implementation of highly multi-agent reasoning models while collaborating with deep learning researchers, product managers, and external scientific partners. You will lead software engineering for the Co-Scientist team in Zurich. The Google Cloud AI Research team addresses AI challenges motivated by Google Cloud’s mission of bringing AI to tech, healthcare, finance, retail and many other industries. We work on a range of unique problems focused on research topics that maximize scientific and real-world impact, aiming to push the state-of-the-art in AI and share findings with the broader research community. We also collaborate with product teams to bring innovations to real-world impact that benefits our customers.
 Responsibilities

• Own projects end-to-end, from initial scientific research concepts through software design, testing, deployment, and performance analysis.

• Build and deploy agentic AI systems, implementing multi-agent prompting techniques and asynchronous task execution frameworks.

• Drive technical decisions and full-stack software development using Python, C++, and Google's core back-end components.

• Design and establish robust evaluation pipelines, automated test suites, and diagnostic datasets to measure agent performance under extreme scale.

• Collaborate on research with Google DeepMind, Google Research, and university labs to solve complex scientific problems, while mentoring junior engineers and advocating engineering quality.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nella maggior parte dei casi, questa posizione richiede interviste in persona come parte del processo di assunzione

Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 5 anni di esperienza con lo sviluppo del software, tra cui test e lancio di prodotti software.

• 3 anni di esperienza ottimizzando l'infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, distribuzione del modello, valutazione del modello, elaborazione dei dati, debugging, fine tuning).

• 2 anni di esperienza con le tecniche GenAI (ad esempio, Modelli di Lingua Grande (LLM), Modelli Multi-Modal, Modelli di Grande Visione) o con concetti correlati a GenAI (modello di lingua, visione del computer).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale, PhD o Postdoc in Informatica, matematica applicata, scienze computazionali, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.

• 3 anni di esperienza con quadri di apprendimento profondi (ad esempio, JAX, TensorFlow, PyTorch) e background algoritmico.

• 1 anno di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica.

• Esperienza guida indipendente, sviluppo software di ricerca-ascendente e tradurre teorie accademiche in prodotti scalabili.

• Registrazione di contributi tecnici o scientifici a progetti complessi e su larga scala.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con le opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Con la tua esperienza tecnica gestirai le priorità del progetto, le scadenze e i materiali di consegna. Potrai progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni software.

Co-Scientist è un sistema AI multi-agente costruito su Gemini progettato per agire come un collega scientifico virtuale autonomo. Utilizza un approccio generativo, di dibattito e di evoluzione per accelerare la scoperta scientifica che consente ai ricercatori di sintetizzare la letteratura, valutare le ipotesi e ottimizzare i progetti sperimentali.

In qualità di Staff Research Software Engineer (R-SWE), si agirà come un ponte tecnico principale, traducendo la ricerca AI scientifica in sistemi software robusti, scalabili e intuitivi. Condurrai la progettazione e l'implementazione di modelli di ragionamento altamente multi-agenti, collaborando con ricercatori, product manager e partner scientifici esterni. Potrai guidare l'ingegneria software per il team Co-Scienziato di Zurigo. Il team di Google Cloud AI Research affronta le sfide di AI motivate dalla missione di Google Cloud di portare AI in tecnologia, salute, finanza, vendita al dettaglio e molti altri settori. Lavoriamo su una serie di problemi unici focalizzati su argomenti di ricerca che massimizzano l'impatto scientifico e reale, mirando a spingere lo stato dell'arte in AI e condividere i risultati con la più ampia comunità di ricerca. Collaboriamo anche con i team di prodotti per portare innovazioni a impatto reale che avvantaggiano i nostri clienti.
responsabilità

• Progetti propri end-to-end, dai primi concetti di ricerca scientifica attraverso la progettazione del software, test, distribuzione e analisi delle prestazioni.

• Costruire e implementare sistemi AI agentici, implementando tecniche di attivazione multi-agenti e quadri di esecuzione asincroni.

• Guidare le decisioni tecniche e lo sviluppo di software a pieno ritmo utilizzando Python, C++ e componenti di back-end di Google.

• Progettare e stabilire linee di valutazione robuste, suite di test automatizzate e set di dati diagnostici per misurare le prestazioni dell'agente in scala estrema.

• Collaborare alla ricerca con Google DeepMind, Google Research e laboratori universitari per risolvere complessi problemi scientifici, mentre mentoring ingegneri junior e sostenendo la qualità dell'ingegneria.

• Aufzeichnung der technischen oder wissenschaftlichen Beiträge zu komplexen Großprojekten.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern Informationen miteinander verbinden, erforschen und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Geschäft wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und begeistert zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Mit Ihrer technischen Expertise verwalten Sie Projektprioritäten, Termine und Ergebnisse. Sie entwerfen, entwickeln, testen, implementieren, warten und verbessern Softwarelösungen.

Co-Scientist ist ein Multi-Agenten-KI-System, das auf Gemini basiert und als autonomer virtueller wissenschaftlicher Kollege fungiert. Es nutzt einen generierenden, debattierenden und entwickelnden Ansatz, um wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen zu beschleunigen, die es Forschern ermöglichen, Literatur zu synthetisieren, Hypothesen zu bewerten und experimentelle Designs zu optimieren.

Als Staff Research Software Engineer (R-SWE) fungieren Sie als wichtigste technische Brücke und übersetzen wissenschaftliche KI-Forschung in robuste, skalierbare und intuitive Softwaresysteme. Sie werden das Design und die Implementierung von Modellen für das Denken von mehreren Agenten leiten und gleichzeitig mit Deep-Learning-Forschern, Produktmanagern und externen wissenschaftlichen Partnern zusammenarbeiten. Du wirst Software Engineering für das Co-Scientist Team in Zürich leiten. Das Google Cloud AI Research-Team befasst sich mit KI-Herausforderungen, die durch die Mission von Google Cloud motiviert sind, KI in die Branchen Technologie, Gesundheitswesen, Finanzen, Einzelhandel und viele andere zu bringen. Wir arbeiten an einer Reihe einzigartiger Probleme, die sich auf Forschungsthemen konzentrieren, die die wissenschaftlichen und realen Auswirkungen maximieren, um den neuesten Stand der KI zu erreichen und die Ergebnisse mit der breiteren Forschungsgemeinschaft zu teilen. Wir arbeiten auch mit Produktteams zusammen, um Innovationen zu realen Auswirkungen zu bringen, von denen unsere Kunden profitieren.
Zuständigkeiten

• Eigene Projekte Ende-zu-Ende, von anfänglichen wissenschaftlichen Forschungskonzepten über Software-Design, Testen, Deployment und Performance-Analyse.

• Aufbau und Bereitstellung agentischer KI-Systeme, Implementierung von Multi-Agenten-Anforderungstechniken und asynchronen Task-Execution-Frameworks.

• Führen Sie technische Entscheidungen und Full-Stack-Softwareentwicklung mit Python, C++ und Googles Kern Backend-Komponenten.

• Design und Etablierung robuster Evaluationspipelines, automatisierter Testsuiten und Diagnosedatensätze zur Messung der Agentenleistung unter extremen Maßstäben.

• Arbeiten Sie mit Google DeepMind, Google Research und Universitätslabors zusammen, um komplexe wissenschaftliche Probleme zu lösen, während Sie junge Ingenieure betreuen und sich für technische Qualität einsetzen.

Grâce à votre expertise technique, vous gérerez les priorités du projet, les échéances et les produits livrables. Vous allez concevoir, développer, tester, déployer, maintenir et améliorer des solutions logicielles.

Il utilise une approche de génération, de débat et d'évolution pour accélérer la découverte scientifique permettant aux chercheurs de synthétiser la littérature, d'évaluer les hypothèses et d'optimiser les conceptions expérimentales.

En tant qu'ingénieur de logiciels de recherche du personnel (R-SWE), vous jouerez le rôle de pont technique principal, traduisant la recherche scientifique sur l'IA en systèmes logiciels robustes, évolutifs et intuitifs. Vous dirigerez la conception et la mise en oeuvre de modèles de raisonnement hautement polyvalents tout en collaborant avec des chercheurs en apprentissage profond, des gestionnaires de produits et des partenaires scientifiques externes. Vous dirigerez l'ingénierie logicielle pour l'équipe Co-Scientifiques à Zurich. L'équipe de recherche sur l'IA de Google Cloud s'attaque aux défis de l'IA motivés par la mission de l'IA dans les domaines de la technologie, des soins de santé, des finances, du commerce de détail et de nombreuses autres industries. Nous travaillons sur une gamme de problèmes uniques axés sur des sujets de recherche qui maximisent l'impact scientifique et réel, dans le but de faire progresser l'état de l'intelligence artificielle et de partager les résultats avec l'ensemble de la communauté de recherche. Nous collaborons également avec des équipes de produits pour apporter des innovations à l'impact réel qui profite à nos clients.
Responsabilités

• Projets de bout en bout, des concepts de recherche scientifique initiale à la conception de logiciels, aux essais, au déploiement et à l'analyse des performances.

• Construire et déployer des systèmes d'intelligence artificielle, mettre en œuvre des techniques d'impulsion multi-agents et des cadres d'exécution des tâches asynchrones.

• Dirigez les décisions techniques et le développement de logiciels complets à l'aide des composants de base Python, C++ et Google.

• Concevoir et établir des pipelines d'évaluation robustes, des suites d'essai automatisées et des ensembles de données diagnostiques pour mesurer la performance des agents à l'échelle extrême.

• Collaborer à la recherche avec Google DeepMind, Google Research et les laboratoires universitaires pour résoudre des problèmes scientifiques complexes, tout en mentorant les ingénieurs subalternes et en défendant la qualité de l'ingénierie.

Please complete your application before December 13, 2026. We encourage you to apply as early as possible as we review applications on a rolling basis.

To start the application process, you will need an updated CV or resume and a current unofficial or official transcript in English. Click on the “Apply” button on this page and provide the required materials in the appropriate sections (PDFs preferred):

Google welcomes people with disabilities.
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Zürich, Switzerland; Berlin, Germany; Munich, Germany; Grenoble, France; Paris, France; Accra, Ghana; Amsterdam, Netherlands; Stockholm, Sweden; London, UK.

Minimum qualifications:

• Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Computer Science, Linguistics, Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Mathematics, Operations Research, Economics, or Natural Sciences, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience in one area of computer science (e.g., Natural Language Understanding, Human Computer Interactions, Generative Media, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Quantum Information Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, or similar areas).

Preferred qualifications:

• Currently enrolled in a full-time degree program in EMEA and returning to the program after completion of the internship.

• Experience as a researcher, including internships, full-time, or at a lab.

• Experience contributing to research communities or efforts, including publishing papers in major conferences or journals.

• Experience with one or more general purpose programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Java, MATLAB, Go, Python, etc.).

About the job
 The Student Researcher Program fosters academic collaborations by hiring students onto research projects aligned to company priorities in scientific advancement. The program offers placements on teams across Google, for research, engineering, and science roles. As a Student Researcher, you will have the opportunity to participate in research projects focused on developing solutions for real-world, large-scale problems.
 Student Researcher projects are exploratory and direct experiences that drive scientific advancement across a multitude of research areas. Students will work collaboratively on projects that explore innovative research challenges and support the creation of breakthrough technologies.
 This engagement is intended for students enrolled in an accredited Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree program located in the EMEA region . Participation in the Student Researcher Program requires that you maintain student status, and are located in one of the specific country locations identified for this role relevant to the project, for the full duration of the engagement . Projects can vary in duration and time commitment depending on needs, ranging from part-time to full time.
 When you apply, you will be considered for Student Researcher positions across all of Google's research teams - including DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud and more. This allows us to find the right project match for your skills and interests.
 Researchers across Google are working to advance the state of the art in computing and build the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we invest in foundational research and work on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Whether we're shaping the future of sustainability, optimizing algorithms, or pioneering AI systems, our teams strive to continuously progress science, advance society, and improve the lives of billions of people.
 Google Research is building the next generation of intelligent systems for all Google products. To achieve this, we’re working on projects that utilize the latest computer science techniques developed by skilled software developers and research scientists. Google Research teams collaborate closely with other teams across Google, maintaining the flexibility and versatility required to adapt new projects and foci that meet the demands of the world's fast-paced business needs.

Si prega di compilare la domanda prima del 13 dicembre 2026. Vi incoraggiamo ad applicare il più presto possibile le applicazioni di revisione su una base di rotolamento.
La sincronizzazione quando si può sentire indietro varia e può richiedere fino a 90+ giorni. Se non avete sentito da noi in tre mesi circa una domanda, probabilmente abbiamo proceduto con altri candidati per quel ruolo particolare. Tuttavia, i nostri reclutatori potrebbero raggiungere se troviamo un diverso potenziale match per le vostre abilità, interessi e esperienza.
Per avviare il processo di applicazione, è necessario un CV aggiornato o un curriculum e una trascrizione ufficiale o ufficiale corrente in inglese. Fare clic sul pulsante “Applica” in questa pagina e fornire i materiali richiesti nelle sezioni appropriate (preferiti PDF):

1. Nella sezione “Risume:” allegare un CV o un curriculum aggiornato
2. Nella sezione “Istruzione:” allegare una trascrizione ufficiale o non ufficiale corrente o recente in inglese.
Sotto “Digitare lo stato”, selezionare “Ora partecipare” per caricare una trascrizione.
Per i richiedenti della Francia:
Google accoglie persone con disabilità.
Nota: Applicando a questa posizione avrai l'opportunità di condividere la tua posizione di lavoro preferita da: Zurigo, Svizzera; Berlino, Germania; Monaco, Germania; Grenoble, Francia; Parigi, Francia; Accra, Ghana; Amsterdam, Paesi Bassi; Stoccolma, Svezia; Londra, Regno Unito.

Titolo minimo:

• Attualmente perseguire una laurea, Master, o PhD laurea in Informatica, Linguistica, Statistica, Biostatistica, Matematica applicata, Operazioni di ricerca, Economia o Scienze Naturali, o equivalente esperienza pratica.

• Esperienza in un'area di informatica (ad esempio, comprensione della lingua naturale, interazioni del computer umano, media generativi, visione del computer, apprendimento della macchina, apprendimento profondo, fondazioni algoritmiche di ottimizzazione, scienza dell'informazione quantistica, scienza dei dati, ingegneria del software, o aree simili).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Attualmente iscritta in un corso di laurea a tempo pieno in EMEA e di ritorno al programma dopo il completamento dello stage.

• Esperienza come ricercatore, tra cui stage, a tempo pieno, o in un laboratorio.

• Esperienza contribuendo a comunità o sforzi di ricerca, tra cui pubblicazioni in grandi conferenze o riviste.

• Esperienza con uno o più linguaggi di programmazione generali (ad esempio, C/C++, Java, MATLAB, Go, Python, ecc.).

Riguardo al lavoro
Lo Student Researcher Program promuove collaborazioni accademiche assumendo gli studenti sui progetti di ricerca allineati alle priorità aziendali nel progresso scientifico. Il programma offre posizionamenti su team di Google, per la ricerca, ingegneria e ruoli scientifici. Come Ricercatore Studente, avrete l'opportunità di partecipare a progetti di ricerca focalizzati sullo sviluppo di soluzioni per problemi reali, su larga scala.
I progetti dei ricercatori degli studenti sono esperienze esplorative e dirette che spingono il progresso scientifico in una moltitudine di aree di ricerca. Gli studenti lavoreranno collaborativamente su progetti che esplorano sfide di ricerca innovative e supportano la creazione di tecnologie innovative.
Il programma è aperto agli studenti iscritti a un Bachelor, Master, o PhD programma. I progetti variano in durata e posizione in base alle esigenze di team e studenti. È necessario che si trova in una delle località specifiche paese identificato per questo ruolo per tutta la durata del fidanzamento. Quando ti applichi, sarai considerato per le posizioni di Ricercatore Studente in tutti i team di ricerca di Google - tra cui DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud e altro ancora. Questo ci permette di trovare la giusta corrispondenza di progetto per le vostre competenze e interessi.
I ricercatori di Google stanno lavorando per far progredire lo stato dell'arte nel calcolo e costruire la prossima generazione di sistemi intelligenti per tutti i prodotti di Google. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, investiamo nella ricerca fondamentale e lavoriamo su progetti che utilizzano le più recenti tecniche informatiche sviluppate da esperti sviluppatori di software e scienziati di ricerca. Che stiamo plasmando il futuro della sostenibilità, ottimizzando gli algoritmi o i sistemi AI pionieristici, i nostri team si sforzano di progredire continuamente la scienza, avanzare la società e migliorare la vita di miliardi di persone.
Google Research sta costruendo la prossima generazione di sistemi intelligenti per tutti i prodotti di Google. Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, stiamo lavorando su progetti che utilizzano le più recenti tecniche di informatica sviluppate da sviluppatori di software qualificati e scienziati di ricerca. I team di Google Research collaborano a stretto contatto con altri team di Google, mantenendo la flessibilità e la versatilità necessarie per adattare nuovi progetti e foci che rispondono alle esigenze delle esigenze aziendali veloci del mondo.
La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti.

• Erfahrung in einem Bereich der Informatik (z. B. Natural Language Understanding, Human Computer Interactions, Generative Media, Computer Vision, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Algorithmic Foundations of Optimization, Quantum Information Science, Data Science, Software Engineering oder ähnliche Bereiche).

Bevorzugte Qualifikationen:

• Derzeit eingeschrieben in einem Vollzeit-Studiengang in EMEA und Rückkehr in das Programm nach Abschluss des Praktikums.

• Erfahrung als Forscher, einschließlich Praktika, Vollzeit oder in einem Labor.

• Erfahrung mit Beiträgen zu Forschungsgemeinschaften oder -bemühungen, einschließlich der Veröffentlichung von Artikeln in großen Konferenzen oder Zeitschriften.

• Erfahrung mit einer oder mehreren allgemeinen Programmiersprachen (z. B. C/C++, Java, MATLAB, Go, Python usw.).

Über den Job
Das Student Researcher Program fördert akademische Kooperationen, indem Studenten für Forschungsprojekte eingestellt werden, die auf die Prioritäten des Unternehmens im wissenschaftlichen Fortschritt ausgerichtet sind. Das Programm bietet Platzierungen in Teams in ganz Google, für Forschung, Technik und Wissenschaft Rollen. Als Student Researcher haben Sie die Möglichkeit, an Forschungsprojekten teilzunehmen, die sich auf die Entwicklung von Lösungen für reale, große Probleme konzentrieren.
Student Researcher-Projekte sind explorative und direkte Erfahrungen, die den wissenschaftlichen Fortschritt in einer Vielzahl von Forschungsbereichen vorantreiben. Die Studierenden werden gemeinsam an Projekten arbeiten, die innovative Forschungsherausforderungen untersuchen und die Schaffung bahnbrechender Technologien unterstützen.
Das Programm ist offen für Studierende in einem Bachelor-, Master- oder PhD-Programm eingeschrieben. Projekte variieren in Dauer und Standort basierend auf Team- und Studentenanforderungen. Es ist erforderlich, dass Sie sich während der gesamten Dauer des Engagements an einem der spezifischen Länderstandorte befinden, die für diese Rolle identifiziert wurden. Wenn Sie sich bewerben, werden Sie für Student Researcher Positionen in allen Google-Forschungsteams in Betracht gezogen - einschließlich DeepMind, Google Research, Google Cloud und mehr. Dies ermöglicht es uns, das richtige Projekt für Ihre Fähigkeiten und Interessen zu finden.
Google-Forscher arbeiten daran, den neuesten Stand der Technik im Bereich Computing voranzutreiben und die nächste Generation intelligenter Systeme für alle Google-Produkte zu entwickeln. Um dies zu erreichen, investieren wir in grundlegende Forschung und arbeiten an Projekten, die die neuesten Informatiktechniken nutzen, die von erfahrenen Softwareentwicklern und Forschern entwickelt wurden. Ob wir die Zukunft der Nachhaltigkeit gestalten, Algorithmen optimieren oder wegweisende KI-Systeme entwickeln, unsere Teams sind bestrebt, die Wissenschaft kontinuierlich voranzutreiben, die Gesellschaft voranzubringen und das Leben von Milliarden von Menschen zu verbessern.
Google Research entwickelt die nächste Generation intelligenter Systeme für alle Google-Produkte. Um dies zu erreichen, arbeiten wir an Projekten, die die neuesten Informatiktechniken nutzen, die von erfahrenen Softwareentwicklern und Forschungswissenschaftlern entwickelt wurden. Google Research-Teams arbeiten eng mit anderen Teams in Google zusammen und behalten die Flexibilität und Vielseitigkeit bei, die erforderlich ist, um neue Projekte und Schwerpunkte anzupassen, die den Anforderungen der schnelllebigen Geschäftsanforderungen der Welt gerecht werden.
Die individuelle Bezahlung wird durch Faktoren wie berufsbezogene Fähigkeiten, Erfahrung und relevante Bildung oder Ausbildung bestimmt.

Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. In this role, with your technical expertise you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.Google Ads is helping power the open internet with the best technology that connects and creates value for people, publishers, advertisers, and Google. We’re made up of multiple teams, building Google’s Advertising products including search, display, shopping, travel and video advertising, as well as analytics. Our teams create trusted experiences between people and businesses with useful ads. We help grow businesses of all sizes from small businesses, to large brands, to YouTube creators, with effective advertiser tools that deliver measurable results. We also enable Google to engage with customers at scale.

• Own projects end-to-end from initial idea to design, analysis, and implementation.

• Perform model training, evaluation, and deployment to solve business-critical problems.This includes exploration of new model architectures, augmenting existing training data, finding better evaluation methods and feedback signals, and identifying headroom opportunities.

• Understand production systems, visualize, monitor, and optimize performance.

• Stay up-to-date with latest tools and research in the field working actively with our collaborators.

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. Als Software-Ingenieur arbeiten Sie an einem bestimmten Projekt, das für die Bedürfnisse von Google von entscheidender Bedeutung ist, mit Möglichkeiten, Teams und Projekte zu wechseln, während Sie und unser schnelllebiges Unternehmen wachsen und sich weiterentwickeln. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, die vielseitig sind, Führungsqualitäten zeigen und begeistert sind, neue Probleme auf der ganzen Welt anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

In dieser Rolle verwalten Sie mit Ihrem technischen Fachwissen Projektprioritäten, Termine und Ergebnisse. Sie entwerfen, entwickeln, testen, implementieren, warten und verbessern Softwarelösungen. Google Ads unterstützt das offene Internet mit der besten Technologie, die Menschen, Publisher, Werbetreibende und Google verbindet und Mehrwert schafft. Wir bestehen aus mehreren Teams, die Google-Werbeprodukte entwickeln, einschließlich Such-, Anzeige-, Einkaufs-, Reise- und Videowerbung sowie Analysen. Unsere Teams schaffen vertrauenswürdige Erfahrungen zwischen Menschen und Unternehmen mit nützlichen Anzeigen. Wir helfen Unternehmen jeder Größe, von kleinen Unternehmen über große Marken bis hin zu YouTube-Erstellern, mit effektiven Werbetreibenden-Tools, die messbare Ergebnisse liefern. Wir ermöglichen es Google auch, mit Kunden in großem Maßstab zu interagieren.

• Eigene Projekte end-to-end von der ersten Idee über Design, Analyse und Umsetzung.

• Führen Sie Modellschulungen, -bewertungen und -bereitstellung durch, um geschäftskritische Probleme zu lösen. Dazu gehören die Erkundung neuer Modellarchitekturen, die Erweiterung bestehender Trainingsdaten, die Suche nach besseren Bewertungsmethoden und Feedbacksignalen sowie die Identifizierung von Möglichkeiten für den Headroom.

• Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden mit den neuesten Tools und der Forschung in diesem Bereich und arbeiten Sie aktiv mit unseren Mitarbeitern zusammen.

Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie Milliarden von Nutzern Informationen miteinander verbinden, erforschen und interagieren. Wir brauchen unsere Ingenieure, um vielseitig zu sein, Führungsqualitäten zu zeigen und enthusiastisch zu sein, neue Probleme auf dem gesamten Stapel anzunehmen, während wir die Technologie weiter vorantreiben.

Teams in diesem Bereich erforschen, entwerfen und entwickeln neue Technologien, um die Interaktion unserer Benutzer mit dem Computing schneller und nahtloser zu gestalten und innovative Erlebnisse für unsere Benutzer auf der ganzen Welt zu schaffen.

jobs.description:
Minimum qualifications:

• PhD in Machine Learning, natural language processing, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Experience with software development using Python and one or more deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch or JAX).

• Research experience in post-training, reinforcement learning (RL), agentic RL, preference learning, or reward modeling.

• First-author (or co-author) publication in one or more peer-reviewed machine learning or natural language processing (NLP) conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP).

Preferred qualifications:

• First-author publications at top ML/NLP venues (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP).

• Experience with modern alignment and post-training methods (e.g., RLHF, DPO, PPO, rejection sampling, or self-play).

• Experience modeling multi-turn interaction data, agent trajectories/logs, or user feedback (implicit and explicit signals).

• Experience training or evaluating reward models, critique models, or automated evaluators (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge).

• Experience in agentic post-training.

About the job
As a part of the Gemini User Signals team, a Research Scientist will help drive the post-training strategy of our most advanced models, dedicated to establishing the "flywheel" of alignment, converting complex user interactions and feedback into training signals that fundamentally improve model behavior. In this role, you will lead research into reward modeling, preference optimization, and data-centric strategies to close the loop between user deployment and model training. You will help define the horizontal recipes that allow us to scale these insights across different modalities and model families.Artificial intelligence will be one of humanity’s most transformative inventions. At Google DeepMind, we are a pioneering AI lab with exceptional interdisciplinary teams focused on advancing AI development to solve complex global challenges and accelerate high-quality product innovation for billions of users. We use our technologies for widespread public benefit and scientific discovery, ensuring safety and ethics are always our highest priority.

We are pushing the boundaries across multiple domains. Our global teams offer varied learning opportunities and career pathways for those driven to achieve exceptional results through collective effort.
 Responsibilities

• Design and implement mechanisms to harvest, filter, and utilize high-quality user signals (implicit and explicit) to iteratively improve Gemini models.

• Develop and refine reward models and critique models that accurately capture user intent and satisfaction, serving as the foundation for Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) and other alignment techniques.

• Create and validate "horizontal" post-training recipes that can be robustly applied across different model sizes and modalities (including text and audio).

• Investigate novel methods for weighting, synthesizing, and selecting data to maximize the impact of user signals on model performance.

• Establish rigorous evaluation frameworks to measure the correlation between offline metrics (reward model accuracy) and online user satisfaction.

• Prova a modellare dati di interazione multi-turn, traiettorie/log dell'agente o feedback dell'utente (segnamenti impliciti ed espliciti).

Riguardo al lavoro
Come parte del team Gemini User Signals, uno scienziato di ricerca aiuterà a guidare la strategia di post-training dei nostri modelli più avanzati, dedicato a stabilire il "volante" di allineamento, convertire complesse interazioni utente e feedback in segnali di formazione che fondamentalmente migliorare il comportamento del modello. In questo ruolo, si porterà la ricerca nella modellazione della ricompensa, ottimizzazione delle preferenze e strategie data-centric per chiudere il loop tra l'implementazione degli utenti e la formazione del modello. Ti aiuterà a definire le ricette orizzontali che ci permettono di scalare queste intuizioni in diverse modalità e famiglie modello. L’intelligenza artificiale sarà una delle invenzioni più trasformative dell’umanità. Utilizziamo le nostre tecnologie per un ampio beneficio pubblico e una scoperta scientifica, assicurando la sicurezza e l'etica sono sempre la nostra massima priorità.

responsabilità

• Progettare e implementare meccanismi per raccogliere, filtrare e utilizzare segnali utente di alta qualità (impliciti ed espliciti) per migliorare in modo iterativo i modelli Gemini.

• Sviluppare e affinare modelli di ricompensa e modelli di critica che catturano con precisione l'intento e la soddisfazione dell'utente, servendo come base per l'apprendimento di rinforzo da Human Feedback (RLHF) e altre tecniche di allineamento.

• Creare e convalidare ricette post-training "orizzontali" che possono essere applicate in modo robusto in diverse dimensioni e modalità del modello (tra cui testo e audio).

• Indagare nuovi metodi per pesare, sintetizzare e selezionare i dati per massimizzare l'impatto dei segnali utente sulle prestazioni del modello.

• Stabilire rigorosi framework di valutazione per misurare la correlazione tra metriche offline (ricompensa l'accuratezza del modello) e la soddisfazione dell'utente online.

• Erleben Sie Training oder Bewertung von Belohnungsmodellen, Kritikmodellen oder automatisierten Bewertern (z. B. LLM-as-a-Richter).

Über den Job
Als Teil des Gemini User Signals-Teams wird ein Research Scientist dazu beitragen, die Post-Training-Strategie unserer fortschrittlichsten Modelle voranzutreiben, die sich der Etablierung des "Flywheel" der Ausrichtung widmen und komplexe Benutzerinteraktionen und Feedback in Trainingssignale umwandeln, die das Modellverhalten grundlegend verbessern. In dieser Rolle leiten Sie die Forschung zu Belohnungsmodellierung, Präferenzoptimierung und datenzentrierten Strategien, um die Schleife zwischen Benutzerbereitstellung und Modellschulung zu schließen. Sie werden helfen, die horizontalen Rezepte zu definieren, mit denen wir diese Erkenntnisse über verschiedene Modalitäten und Modellfamilien skalieren können. Künstliche Intelligenz wird eine der transformativsten Erfindungen der Menschheit sein. Bei Google DeepMind sind wir ein wegweisendes KI-Labor mit außergewöhnlichen interdisziplinären Teams, die sich darauf konzentrieren, die KI-Entwicklung voranzutreiben, um komplexe globale Herausforderungen zu lösen und qualitativ hochwertige Produktinnovationen für Milliarden von Nutzern zu beschleunigen. Wir nutzen unsere Technologien für den breiten öffentlichen Nutzen und wissenschaftliche Entdeckungen, Sicherheit und Ethik sind immer unsere höchste Priorität.

Wir verschieben die Grenzen über mehrere Domänen hinweg. Unsere globalen Teams bieten vielfältige Lernmöglichkeiten und Karrierewege für diejenigen, die durch gemeinsame Anstrengungen außergewöhnliche Ergebnisse erzielen wollen.
Zuständigkeiten

• Entwerfen und implementieren Sie Mechanismen zum Sammeln, Filtern und Verwenden hochwertiger Benutzersignale (implizit und explizit), um Gemini-Modelle iterativ zu verbessern.

• Entwickeln und verfeinern Sie Belohnungsmodelle und Kritikmodelle, die Benutzerabsicht und -zufriedenheit genau erfassen und als Grundlage für Reinforcement Learning aus menschlichem Feedback (RLHF) und andere Ausrichtungstechniken dienen.

• Erstellen und validieren Sie "horizontale" Nachschulungsrezepte, die robust auf verschiedene Modellgrößen und -modalitäten (einschließlich Text und Audio) angewendet werden können.

• Untersuchen Sie neuartige Methoden zum Gewichten, Synthetisieren und Auswählen von Daten, um die Auswirkungen von Benutzersignalen auf die Modellleistung zu maximieren.

• Etablieren Sie strenge Bewertungsrahmen, um die Korrelation zwischen Offline-Metriken (Genauigkeit des Belohnungsmodells) und der Online-Benutzerzufriedenheit zu messen.

• Publications des premiers auteurs dans les principaux sites du ML/NLP (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, EMNLP).

• Expérience en post-formation.

Sur le travail
Dans le cadre de l'équipe Gemini User Signals, un chercheur scientifique aidera à piloter la stratégie post-formation de nos modèles les plus avancés, dédié à l'établissement de la « roue volante » de l'alignement, la conversion d'interactions utilisateur complexes et de rétroaction en signaux de formation qui améliorent fondamentalement le comportement du modèle. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez la recherche sur la modélisation de récompense, l'optimisation des préférences et les stratégies centrées sur les données pour fermer la boucle entre le déploiement des utilisateurs et la formation des modèles. Vous aiderez à définir les recettes horizontales qui nous permettent d'évaluer ces idées à travers différentes modalités et familles modèles. L'intelligence artificielle sera l'une des inventions les plus transformatrices de l'humanité. Chez Google DeepMind, nous sommes un laboratoire d'IA pionnier avec des équipes interdisciplinaires exceptionnelles qui visent à faire progresser le développement de l'IA pour résoudre des défis mondiaux complexes et accélérer l'innovation de produits de haute qualité pour des milliards d'utilisateurs. Nous utilisons nos technologies à des fins d'intérêt général et de découverte scientifique, en veillant à ce que la sécurité et l'éthique soient toujours notre priorité absolue.

Nous repoussons les frontières entre plusieurs domaines. Nos équipes mondiales offrent des possibilités d'apprentissage et des parcours de carrière variés pour ceux qui sont motivés par des résultats exceptionnels grâce à des efforts collectifs.
Responsabilités

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des mécanismes pour récolter, filtrer et utiliser des signaux d'utilisateur de haute qualité (implicits et explicites) pour améliorer les modèles Gemini.

• Élaborer et affiner des modèles de récompense et des modèles de critique qui tiennent compte avec précision de l'intention et de la satisfaction des utilisateurs, servant de fondement à l'apprentissage du renforcement par la rétroaction humaine (RLHF) et à d'autres techniques d'alignement.

• Créer et valider des recettes "horizontales" post-formation qui peuvent être appliquées avec robustesse selon les tailles et les modalités du modèle (y compris le texte et l'audio).

• Étudier de nouvelles méthodes de pondération, de synthèse et de sélection des données pour maximiser l'impact des signaux des utilisateurs sur la performance du modèle.

• Établir des cadres d'évaluation rigoureux pour mesurer la corrélation entre les mesures hors ligne (exactitude du modèle de récompense) et la satisfaction des utilisateurs en ligne.

Minimum qualifications:

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience with full stack development, across back-end such as Java, Python, Golang, or C++ codebases, and front-end experience including JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, CSS or equivalent.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience developing accessible technologies.

• Experience integrating generative AI tools or LLM interfaces into workflows.

About the job
 Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

In this role, you will design, build, and launch end-to-end generative AI and agentic capabilities that help viewers research, compare, and buy products recommended by creators they trust. Working across the YouTube Shopping and Search stack, you will develop LLM prompts, modular skills, tool integrations (such as live product catalog and affiliate offer retrieval), and interactive shopping UI components (such as product comparison tables, shoppable video indicators, and seamless Search-to-Watch handoffs). You will partner closely with engineers, TLs, PMs, and UX designers across YouTube Shopping and core YouTube Search/Ask teams to take features from rapid prototyping and offline evaluation (Autoraters) to A/B experimentation and global production launch.
 At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.

• Build agentic workflows, modular LLM skills, prompts, and backend tool integrations for conversational responses in live, verified YouTube Shopping product metadata and creator perspectives.

Les ingénieurs logiciels de Google développent les technologies de prochaine génération qui changent comment des milliards d'utilisateurs se connectent, explorent et interagissent avec l'information et les autres. Nous recherchons des ingénieurs qui apportent de nouvelles idées dans tous les domaines, y compris la recherche d'information, l'informatique distribuée, la conception de systèmes à grande échelle, le réseautage et le stockage de données, la sécurité, l'intelligence artificielle, le traitement du langage naturel, la conception d'interface utilisateur et mobile; la liste continue et augmente chaque jour. En tant qu'ingénieur logiciel, vous travaillerez sur un projet spécifique critique pour les besoins de Google avec des occasions de changer d'équipes et de projets que vous et notre entreprise à rythme rapide croître et évoluer. • 7 years of Capital Markets and Exchanges experience designing and architecting solutions for issuance, clearing, trading, settlement, custody, reference, and market data.

• 4 years of experience in software or data engineering with one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, or Java), including experience with design patterns, testing frameworks, and API contract design.

• Experience in Financial Services, including experience with the regulatory and operational rigors of clearing, settlement, or custody.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience designing and implementing smart contracts within regulated Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs). This includes managing the life-cycle of tokenized assets.

• Experience working in a high-maturity DevOps culture (trunk-based development, automated testing, blue/green deployments).

• Proficient in BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.

• Understanding of data residency, encryption at rest/transit (CMEK), and "Explainable AI" requirements in banking.

• Strong understanding of relational, NoSQL, and analytical data modeling (Star Schema, Data Vault, etc.).

• Ability to independently drive the discovery phase, moving from a vague business problem to a structured PRD and a working technical demo.

About the job
In this role, you will operate within the Innovation team, the Capital Markets and Exchanges Solution Architect collaborates with clients to transform initial concepts into reality. You will collaborate in strategic business transformations through designing and architecting cutting-edge solutions across all aspects of trade processing: clearing, issuance, settlement, custody and post trade processing. You will be a trusted advisor to our customers in helping them shape their future through the latest Technologies, tokenization platforms and the flexibility of scaling cloud to enable latency sensitive trading with your deep knowledge of the business, current and horizon technologies.

In this role, you will be an independent, highly motivated and opinionated problem solver, innovator, and builder, able to learn, influence and build trust with a highly complex financial institution. You will be expected to advise on best practices across business and technology to realize innovative solutions using the latest cloud technologies.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €148000 - €151000 (EUR) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Design and architect solutions such as scalable position-keeping services, hybrid financial instruments handling, low latency and stream solutions for trading exchanges.

• Evaluate and integrate solutions with modern data foundations, including Relational Databases, Data Lake Houses, and real-time streaming architectures, ensuring data pipelines are optimized for AI retrieval, agentic workflows, and real-time financial insights.

• Partner with client leads(business user) to create Product Requirement Documents (PRDs), clearly defining Critical User Journeys (CUJs) and success metrics.

• 7 years of Capital Markets and Exchanges experience designing and architecting solutions for issuance, clearing, trading, settlement, custody, reference, and market data.

• 4 years of experience in software or data engineering with one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, Go, or Java), including experience with design patterns, testing frameworks, and API contract design.

• Experience in Financial Services, including experience with the regulatory and operational rigors of clearing, settlement, or custody.

Preferred qualifications:

• Experience designing and implementing smart contracts within regulated Financial Market Infrastructures (FMIs). This includes managing the life-cycle of tokenized assets.

• Experience working in a high-maturity DevOps culture (trunk-based development, automated testing, blue/green deployments).

• Proficient in BigQuery, Vertex AI, Dataflow, and Pub/Sub.

• Understanding of data residency, encryption at rest/transit (CMEK), and "Explainable AI" requirements in banking.

• Strong understanding of relational, NoSQL, and analytical data modeling (Star Schema, Data Vault, etc.).

• Ability to independently drive the discovery phase, moving from a vague business problem to a structured PRD and a working technical demo.

About the job
In this role, you will operate within the Innovation team, the Capital Markets and Exchanges Solution Architect collaborates with clients to transform initial concepts into reality. You will collaborate in strategic business transformations through designing and architecting cutting-edge solutions across all aspects of trade processing: clearing, issuance, settlement, custody and post trade processing. You will be a trusted advisor to our customers in helping them shape their future through the latest Technologies, tokenization platforms and the flexibility of scaling cloud to enable latency sensitive trading with your deep knowledge of the business, current and horizon technologies.

In this role, you will be an independent, highly motivated and opinionated problem solver, innovator, and builder, able to learn, influence and build trust with a highly complex financial institution. You will be expected to advise on best practices across business and technology to realize innovative solutions using the latest cloud technologies.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €148000 - €151000 (EUR) + 20% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience in software development.

• 5 years of experience leading ML design and optimizing ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning).

• 5 years of experience testing, and launching software products, and 3 years of experience with software design and architecture.

• 2 years of experience with state of the art GenAI techniques (e.g., Large Language Model (LLMs), Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) or with GenAI-related concepts (language modeling, computer vision).

• Experience building agentic workflows and tool-calling systems (e.g., with ADK, reasoning loops, multi-agent orchestration).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• 8 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• 3 years of experience in a technical leadership role leading project teams and setting technical direction.

• 3 years of experience working in a complex, matrixed organization involving cross-functional, or cross-business projects.

• Experience with distributed systems, RPC services, database architecture (Spanner/F1), and batch/streaming data pipelines (Flume).

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.

With your technical expertise, you will manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. You will design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance software solutions.
People shop on Google more than a billion times a day - and the Commerce team is responsible for building the experiences that serve these users. The mission for Google Commerce is to be an essential part of the shopping journey for consumers - from inspiration to to a simple and secure checkout experience - and the best place for retailers/merchants to connect with consumers. We support and partner with the commerce ecosystem, from large retailers to small local merchants, to give them the tools, technology and scale to thrive in today’s digital world.
 Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership on high-impact projects.

• Influence and coach a distributed team of engineers.

• Facilitate alignment and clarity across teams on goals, outcomes, and timelines.

• Manage project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables.

• Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and enhance large-scale software solutions.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nella maggior parte dei casi, questa posizione richiede interviste in persona come parte del processo di assunzione.

Titolo minimo:

• Corso di laurea o esperienza pratica equivalente.

• 8 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo del software.

• 5 anni di esperienza leader ML progettazione e ottimizzazione dell'infrastruttura ML (ad esempio, distribuzione del modello, valutazione del modello, elaborazione dei dati, debugging, fine tuning).

• 5 anni di esperienza di test, e lancio di prodotti software, e 3 anni di esperienza con progettazione software e architettura.

• 2 anni di esperienza con le tecniche dell'arte GenAI (ad esempio, Large Language Model (LLM), Multi-Modal, Large Vision Models) o con i concetti legati al GenAI (modello di lingua, visione del computer).

• Sperimenta i flussi di lavoro agentici ed i sistemi di registrazione degli strumenti (ad esempio, con ADK, loop di ragionamento, orchestrazione multi-agent).

Qualifiche preferenziali:

• Laurea magistrale o dottorato in Ingegneria, Informatica, o un campo tecnico correlato.

• 8 anni di esperienza con strutture dati e algoritmi.

• 3 anni di esperienza in un ruolo di leadership tecnica leader team di progetto e la definizione di direzione tecnica.

• 3 anni di esperienza che lavorano in un complesso, matrice organizzazione che coinvolge progetti interfunzionali o cross-business.

• Esperienza con sistemi distribuiti, servizi RPC, architettura database (Spanner/F1), e datadotti batch/streaming (Flume).

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e l'archiviazione di dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. Come ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.

Con la vostra competenza tecnica, gestirete le priorità del progetto, le scadenze e i materiali di consegna. Potrai progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni software.
People shop su Google più di un miliardo di volte al giorno - e il team di Commercio è responsabile per la costruzione delle esperienze che servono questi utenti. La missione per il commercio di Google è di essere una parte essenziale del viaggio di shopping per i consumatori - dall'ispirazione a un'esperienza di checkout semplice e sicura - e il posto migliore per i rivenditori / commercianti di connettersi con i consumatori. Supportiamo e collaboriamo con l’ecosistema del commercio, dai grandi rivenditori ai piccoli commercianti locali, per dare loro gli strumenti, la tecnologia e la scala per prosperare nel mondo digitale di oggi.
responsabilità

• Fornire leadership tecnica su progetti ad alto impatto.

• Influenza e coach un team di ingegneri distribuito.

• Facilita l'allineamento e la chiarezza tra le squadre su obiettivi, risultati e linee temporali.

• Gestisci priorità di progetto, scadenze e consegnabili.

• Progettare, sviluppare, testare, distribuire, mantenere e migliorare le soluzioni software su larga scala.

Über den Job
Die Software-Ingenieure von Google entwickeln Technologien der nächsten Generation, die die Art und Weise verändern, wie sich Milliarden von Nutzern miteinander verbinden, erkunden und interagieren. Unsere Produkte müssen Informationen in großem Umfang verarbeiten und weit über die Websuche hinausgehen. Wir suchen Ingenieure, die frische Ideen aus allen Bereichen einbringen, einschließlich Informationsabruf, verteiltes Computing, groß angelegtes Systemdesign, Netzwerk- und Datenspeicherung, Sicherheit, künstliche Intelligenz, Verarbeitung natürlicher Sprache, UI-Design und Mobile; Die Liste geht weiter und wächst jeden Tag. In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: Munich, Germany; Zürich, Switzerland.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

• 2 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages, or 1 year of experience with an advanced degree.

• 2 years of experience building software for data privacy or security (e.g., identity and access management).

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical fields.

• 2 years of experience with data structures and algorithms.

• Experience with Rust coding language.

• System Architecture, Compilers, Open Source Technologies, Open Source Contributor, Programming Language Implementation experience.

• Security and API Design experience.

• Foundations in security engineering, computer and network security.

About the job
Google's software engineers develop the next-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
The Core team builds the technical foundation behind Google’s flagship products. We are owners and advocates for the underlying design elements, developer platforms, product components, and infrastructure at Google. These are the essential building blocks for excellent, safe, and coherent experiences for our users and drive the pace of innovation for every developer. We look across Google’s products to build central solutions, break down technical barriers and strengthen existing systems. As the Core team, we have a mandate and a unique opportunity to impact important technical decisions across the company.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Germany: €106000 - €108000 (EUR) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google .
 Responsibilities

• Design and implement new techniques and make them work for extremely large scale software systems across many product teams. Help deploy exploit mitigations, retrofit spatial safety to C++ and transition Google to memory safe programming languages such as Rust.

• Build strong partnerships and collaborate with partner teams in Google's Memory Safety program, as well as with industry and academia.

• Fix memory safety across all Google products. From initial security research and tactical exploit mitigations to engineering away classes of problems and addressing their root cause.

• Research and apply innovative techniques for memory safety, from program analysis to machine learning.

Riguardo al lavoro
Gli ingegneri software di Google sviluppano le tecnologie di nuova generazione che cambiano come miliardi di utenti si connettono, esplorano e interagiscono con le informazioni e l'un l'altro. I nostri prodotti hanno bisogno di gestire le informazioni su vasta scala, e estendere ben oltre la ricerca web. Siamo alla ricerca di ingegneri che portano idee fresche da tutte le aree, tra cui il recupero di informazioni, il calcolo distribuito, la progettazione di sistemi su larga scala, la rete e la memorizzazione dei dati, la sicurezza, l'intelligenza artificiale, l'elaborazione del linguaggio naturale, il design dell'interfaccia utente e il mobile; la lista va avanti e sta crescendo ogni giorno. In qualità di ingegnere del software, lavorerai su un progetto specifico critico per le esigenze di Google con opportunità di cambiare team e progetti mentre tu e il nostro business veloce crescere ed evolvere. Abbiamo bisogno che i nostri ingegneri siano versatili, esibiscano qualità di leadership e siano entusiasti di affrontare nuovi problemi in tutto il mondo, mentre continuiamo a spingere avanti la tecnologia.
Il team Core costruisce il fondamento tecnico dietro i prodotti di punta di Google. Siamo proprietari e sostenitori per gli elementi di progettazione sottostanti, piattaforme di sviluppo, componenti di prodotto e infrastrutture a Google. Questi sono i mattoni essenziali per esperienze eccellenti, sicure e coerenti per i nostri utenti e guidare il ritmo di innovazione per ogni sviluppatore. Guardiamo attraverso i prodotti di Google per costruire soluzioni centrali, abbattere le barriere tecniche e rafforzare i sistemi esistenti. Come team Core, abbiamo un mandato e un'opportunità unica per influenzare importanti decisioni tecniche in tutta l'azienda. La retribuzione individuale è determinata da fattori, tra cui competenze, esperienze, istruzione o formazione rilevanti.

Germania: €106000 - €108000 (EUR) + 15% target bonus + equità + prestazioni

Scopri di più sui vantaggi di Google .

jobs.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8 years of experience building and shipping production-grade AI-driven solutions to external or internal customers using Python, TypeScript or comparable languages.

• Experience leading technical discovery sessions with business stakeholders and engineering teams to define AI and hardware infrastructure requirements.

• Experience designing and building AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud Platform (GCP)).

• Experience building pipelines for structured, unstructured data, incorporating vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)-like architectures to power enterprise-grade AI solutions.

Preferred qualifications:

• Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.

• Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, or Google’s Agent Development Kit (ADK)) and patterns like ReAct, self-reflection, and hierarchical delegation.

• Knowledge of large language model native metrics (tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

About the job
 As a GenAI Forward Deployed Engineer at Google Cloud, you will be an embedded builder bridging the gap between frontier AI products and production-grade reality for our customers. You will function as a builder-consultant, moving beyond high-level architecture to code, debug, and jointly ship bespoke agentic solutions directly within the customer’s environment.
 In this role, you will manage blockers to production including solving the integration complexities, data readiness issues, and state-management issues that prevent AI from reaching enterprise-grade maturity. By embedding with accounts, you will serve a dual purpose: providing white-glove deployment of AI systems and acting as a critical feedback loop, transforming real-world field insights into Google Cloud’s future product roadmap.
 It's an exciting time to join Google Cloud’s Go-To-Market team, leading the AI revolution for businesses worldwide. You’ll excel by leveraging Google's brand credibility—a legacy built on inventing foundational technologies and proven at scale. We’ll provide you with the world's most advanced AI portfolio, including frontier Gemini models, and the complete Vertex AI platform, helping you to solve business problems. We’re a collaborative culture providing direct access to DeepMind's engineering and research minds, empowering you to solve customer challenges. Join us to be the catalyst for our mission, drive customer success, and define the new cloud era—the market is yours.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the lead developer for AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, model context protocol servers) that drive measurable return on investment.

• Architect and code the connective tissue between Google’s AI products and customer's live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters.

• Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet rigorous requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.

• Identify repeatable field patterns and technical friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or product feature requests for the Engineering teams.

• Drive engineering excellence by mentoring talent, co-building with customer teams, and influencing cross-functional strategies to uplevel organizational technical capabilities.

Qualifiche preferite:
